HouseRules1: - Intercom. You can provide your visitors with access to the building from within the apartment by using the intercom. Press the button on the intercom handset which will release the main entrance allowing the visitor entry to the lobby. Your visitor can then proceed to the elevator and continue to the floor where the apartment is located. - Air conditioning. The air conditioner is controlled by the Fujitsu panel located in the main entryway beside the intercom. Press the orange button to turn the air conditioner on and off. Use the corresponding buttons to change the mode temperature and fan speed to your preference. - Dishwasher. Pull open the door and place one provided tablet inside the compartment on the inner door panel and then close the door gently until you hear a click. Press the power button to turn the dishwasher on. Use the corresponding buttons and lights to select preferred wash cycle settings. Hold down the selected setting button until you hear a beep and the cycle will begin. Oven/Microwave Press the Convection button once the display screen will read "110C”. Then select the convection cooking temperature by pressing the Convection button again until your desired temperature is displayed on screen. Turn the dial to set the cooking time. For a cooking time of 11 minutes turn the dial knob to the right to set 11:00. Press START/SPEEDY COOK button. The oven light comes on and the turntable starts rotating. Cooking starts and the time in the display will count down. To use as a microwave press the start button to activate a 30 second cycle. Every press of the button will add an additional 30 seconds. Or you can rotate the dial to set the timer. - Stovetop. Bring power to the stovetop using the switch marked ‘HOB’ on the splashback wall. Press and hold the 0/I button to turn the stovetop on. Place your pot/pan on the hotplate then select the hotplate by pressing the respective button. Touch the + or - symbol to adjust the temperature. Turn the stovetop off by flicking the ‘HOB’ switch off at the wall. - Washing Machine. Pull open the door and place a load inside then gently push the door until it clicks shut. Pour the provided laundry liquid into the tray compartment on the left. Press the power button on the right and use the dial to select a cycle. Press the 'Start/Pause' button to begin the cycle. - Dryer Pull open the door and check the filter is empty before placing a load inside. Gently push the door until it clicks shut. Press the power button on the right and use the corresponding buttons to select a cycle. Press the 'Start/Pause' button to begin. Please remove the filter and clean out after each use. - Garbage Disposal. There is a garbage room on each building level located near the lifts

HouseRules1: Council Bins: Council bins are collected on Wednesday morning. If the bins have not been placed on the curb before Sunday afternoon you may see our contractor taking the bins out for you to ensure they get emptied. This property is governed by the Short Stay Rental Accommodation Code Of Conduct. Please ensure you follow these local laws during your stay to avoid a bond claim. 1. Unacceptable behaviour will not be tolerated. 2. All cars must be parked within the premises (not on the street). 3. Additional accommodation is not allowed on site by the way of tents caravans campervans or similar facilities. 4. Outdoor areas including pools spas outdoor decking and balconies are not to be used between the hours of 11pm and 7am. 5. There is to be NO noise at the property between these hours. 6. Noise levels must be kept to a minimum between 7am and 11pm. 5. Please remove any excess rubbish that will not fit into the council bins provided. Please Note: Complaints received by the local council will result in infringement notices in excess of $500 per breach. SEWER AND SEPTIC REQUIREMENTS Houses that are not connected to mains sewerage have their own waste water/septic treatment systems. It is imperative that no foreign matter enters these systems as it can cause a breakdown. All sanitary items need to be disposed of in bins and not flushed down the toilet. Guests will be liable for the cost of fixing the unit if they don’t adhere to these guidelines. CLEANING You are required to leave the property in a neat and tidy state. In the event that the property is not left in a reasonably clean neat and tidy state upon departure the guests agree to an excess cleaning charge. For example cleaning up any excess sand dirt mud from floors all dishes to be cleaned and put back in their original places all furniture to be returned to its original place spillages are cleaned and any serious stains or other issues are reported to us. If this property has a BBQ you are most welcome to use it during your stay. Please ensure the BBQ is cleaned prior to departing. If you choose not to clean the BBQ after your use a $60 cleaning fee will apply. For pet friendly properties all mess/hair/fur/excrement etc is to be totally cleaned and removed prior to departure – both inside and outside the property. Linen is sent away to be commercially laundered so please refrain from placing in washing machine before you leave. Wet bath towels / mats are to be left in shower recess bath or laundry trough for collection. CARE OF HOUSE Smoking is not permitted in any of the accommodation. Please do not place any hot items (posts pans etc.) directly on benches or tables. Please take special care to ensure shoes (such as high heels) do not scratch or mark floors. Taking off shoes and rinsing feet before entering the property will ensure excess dirt and sand does not enter the house. EXTRA GUESTS You are required to advise us if you have extra guests stay with you at the property even if it is only for one night. In the event that additional guests do stay & we have not been previously advised we reserve the right to charge to the credit card the reasonable cost for the additional guests as per the Terms and Conditions agreed to prior to your arrival. NO PARTY POLICY As per the Terms and Conditions agreed upon when booking there is a strict No-Party policy. Mobile patrols by a local security company are undertaken in the late evening to ensure noise is at an appropriate level. If the noise coming from the property is deemed excessive for the time of night the security guard will kindly ask you lower the volume. If PHR receives a noise complaint from a neighbour within the noise restriction times and the security company is required to attend you will be charged a call-out fee and up to $700 will be held for 28 days if we receive a council infringement notice from your stay. Evidence or notice of parties held at your property whereby excessive noise has been reported and/or the police have been called could result in immediate eviction and forfeiture of total monies paid. Any extra cleaning or damage costs as a result will also be charged to you. PROPERTY BELONGINGS We have provided certain essential items such as some cooking supplies hand and body wash for your use whilst staying at the property. Please be mindful that these products are for the enjoyment of future guests also and therefore are not to be removed from the premises. Removal of these products will result in a $50 inconvenience fee. KEYS During your stay you are responsible for the safe keeping of the keys and security of the property. Should you lose the keys you will be charged for a replacement. Please ensue the property is locked at all times when vacant. ITEMS LEFT BEHIND / LOST PROPERTY Please ensure all property belongings remain at the property and all your personal belongings are brought home with you. While we will make every effort to find it for you we take no responsibility if it is not recovered. If the property is found a service fee of $55 is applied to return the property to you by postage. Large or bulky items may incur a higher charge. Items will be held in the office for a maximum of 6 months. If they have not been collected by then items will be discarded/donated. OFFICE OPENING HOURS Monday - Friday: 9am - 5pm Saturday: 10am - 4pm Sunday: 11am - 3pm Please Note: Phone calls outside these hours are for emergencies only. Please be mindful while enjoying your stay that surrounding neighbours live in this community and are entitled to peace and amenity in their residential area thank you.

HouseRules1: Mailboxes: Mailboxes are located inside the foyer on Hassall St. There is a mailbox key with your apartment keys. The mailbox numbers are clearly marked. Doors / Keys/ Remotes: You will be given an apartment front door key mailbox key an access swipe/fob and remote for the car park. Use the access swipe for access to the building main entrance door for access to the gym and to use the lift to your floor from level 1. The front doors to the apartment close automatically AND LOCK - please ensure you have apartment keys with you when you leave the apartment. There is an after hours call out fee for lockouts. Lost keys and security cards will incur fees to replace. Should you lose your key or access swipe the property manager must be advised immediately to cancel access into the building and to order replacement cards and keys. Visitors: Visitors should call your apartment via the remote call panel by the street level entrance to the building. Dial the apartment number and press the ‘bell’ symbol to call the intercom. When you answer the intercom and are happy that the visitor is genuine let them in by pressing the key button on the base which also allows the use of the lift to your floor. No Smoking: Please refrain from smoking inside the apartment and in the common areas of the building. Inventory: The inventory report details all the furnishings crockery cutlery and other wares that are included in your apartment for a comfortable stay. Please check that the inventory is correct at the start of your stay as damages and discrepancies may result in a charge on departure. Electrics panel: In the unlikely event of electricity failure please check the distribution panel first to check for a tripped switch this is located in the cupboard above the fridge. Dishwasher: Only use dishwashing powder. DO NOT use liquid or tablets. Only use half teaspoon of powder in the right hand receptacle. Tall glasses / crockery on side shelves will not wash and may break. Do not stand anything high on the side shelves as this may prevent the dishwasher from sealing and cause water to leak onto the electronics in the machine. Please do not over stack the machine. Garbage: Garbage disposal rooms are located on each level. General waste must be placed in plastic bags and tied securely to prevent odours from escaping. Emergency exits are clearly marked by green signs hanging from the ceilings in the hallways. Please familiarise yourself with the fire exits. In the event of an emergency follow the instructions of any authority. Exit the building following the ‘Exit’ signs via the fire stairs. Emergency lighting will illuminate the emergency egress routes in the event of normal power failure. Do not use the lifts in emergencies. An approval given by the owner’s corporation under clause (1) cannot authorise any additions to the common property. Behaviour of Owners and Occupiers: An owner or occupier of a lot when on common property must be adequately clothed and must not use language or behave in a manner likely to cause offence or embarrassment to the owner or occupier of another lot or to any person lawfully using common property. HouseRules1: • CANDLES/INCENSE: Please do not light candles or incense inside – it is a fire hazard. • CHECK-IN & CHECK-OUT TIMES: Check-in and check-out times are displayed clearly on the listing. Please adhere to these times to allow for smooth transitions between guests. If you are running late you will be required to provide housekeeping with access so they can commence cleaning to prepare for the next guests. • CHECK-OUT PROCEDURE: Please empty the fridge/pantry of opened/perishable food place all rubbish in outside bins ensure that the property is left neat and tidy all dishes to be washed & put away all lights & air con heaters to be switched OFF remove all personal effects and lock all doors to the property when you leave. • COMMUNICATION: We are here to help! If you have any questions or concerns or encounter any issues during your stay please reach out to us through our messaging platform. • COMMUNITY: You should not disturb any common spaces outside the street or create a nuisance that disturbs the surrounding community. Failure to respect the neighbours property manager or community concerns will result in the immediate booking cancellation. • CONSUMABLES: We supply a ‘starter pack’ of consumables upon your check-in. If you run out of these during your stay it is your responsibility to stock them up during your stay depending on your own requirements. • DAMAGES: If you break or damage something during your stay please advise us as soon as practically possible so we can arrange for its replacement or repair promptly. Depending on severity and cost we reserve the right to charge you an applicable fee for reimbursement and/or compensation. • DRINKS & FOOD: Drinks or food must not be consumed in the bedrooms • EXTRA CLEANING CHARGES: Guests are expected to keep the property reasonably clean and tidy during their stay. Excessive mess or negligence may result in additional cleaning fees and will be charged. • FURNITURE: Please do not move any large furniture inside the property. Chairs and smaller furniture must be shifted back to their original location upon departure. • ILLEGAL ACTIVITY: We do not tolerate drugs or illegal activity; in this instance your booking will be cancelled immediately reported to Airbnb and you will be removed from the property. No refunds will be issued. • ITEMS LEFT BEHIND: Please ensure you collect all belongings upon departure as we may not be available to hand back your items same day. If you leave something behind and would like this sent back to you you will be required to pay for postage return of your item(s) which will attract a minimum fee of to cover postage logistics and time to return your item(s). If you are a Perth local and would like to collect your item(s) in person we will get back to you with a time and date that is suitable for you to collect said item/s from our office in Stirling – Please note that we are not always available to attend (due to meetings and out of office appointments) to this same day and you will be issued with a suitable date/time for collection. We do not personally deliver items – it will be your responsibility to collect or arrange for a friend/relative to collect on your behalf. • KITCHEN MATS: When cooking in the kitchen please use the heat mats provided for the kitchen bench dining table and coffee table to place hot items on – do not place hot items directly on these surfaces. • LETTERBOX: The letterbox is generally not available for use during your stay. Please reach out to us if you require mail to be delivered. • NOISE POLICY: We have a strict noise policy; quiet time is strictly from 10:00 pm until 8:00 am please be respectful of all residents who reside in the surrounding areas. If we receive any noise complaints for your property during these hours you will be required to leave the property immediately and your booking will be cancelled. No refunds will be issued. • LINEN: We professionally launder all items such as towels linen tea towels etc please take care when using our bed linen and towels if there are any stains an applicable stain removal fee or replacement fee will be enforced to conduct heavy stain removal treatment or replacement if required. Stains may be caused by heavy makeup fake tan hair dye food drinks etc • LOCKOUTS: If you lock yourself out during your stay we will need to either arrange to meet you onsite to provide you with access or we’ll arrange for our locksmith to attend at their next availability. Call-out charges are a minimum of for us personally to attend due to the inconvenience and travel time caused by this issue. If a locksmith has to be arranged you will be required to pay the invoice in full. Our best endeavours will be used to arrange this immediately. • LOSS OF KEYS/REMOTES/FOBS: If any keys/remotes/fobs are lost during your stay - you will be liable for full replacement costs to have new ones issued. An invoice will be raised via a claim and you will be required to pay the invoice in full. • MAINTENANCE: If maintenance arises during your stay please refer to our guest handbook for simple troubleshooting guides. If the issue persists you must contact us immediately to report any issues. Please report maintenance through the messenger platform provide us with a description of this issue and attach photos. Our best efforts will be utilised to update you and arrange for repairs or rectification. • MAXIMUM OCCUPANCY: The maximum number of guests allowed is as per the listing. Please do not exceed this limit without prior approval. • RESPECT FOR THE PROPERTY: Please treat the property and its contents with care. Any damages or missing items will be the responsibility of the guest and may incur additional charges. • RUBBISH DISPOSAL: We rely on the local council to dispose of the council bins on a weekly basis. Housekeeping does not remove rubbish from bins due to health and hygiene concerns. All guests are responsible for maintaining the council bins and correctly disposing of their rubbish by the council guidelines as outlined in the guest handbook and rubbish management plan. Do not leave rubbish in open areas. If there is an overflow of rubbish at your check-out you will be charged a $100 disposal fee. • SMOKING PROHIBITED TO ALL AREAS: Smoking is strictly prohibited anywhere on the property including but not limited to indoor areas patios backyard and common spaces. This includes traditional cigarettes e-cigarettes cigars pipes and any other smoking devices. Violation of this policy will result in immediate termination of your stay and additional cleaning fees to remove smoke odour and damage. We appreciate your cooperation in maintaining a smoke-free environment for all guests. If the property smells like cigarette smoke upon checkout or cigarette butts have been found inside you will be charged a $200 deodorising fee. • SECURITY AND SAFETY: Guests are responsible for properly securing the property when entering or leaving. Ensure that all doors and windows are locked and any alarm systems are activated. • STILETTOS/ STUDDED SHOES: Please refrain from wearing stilettos/studded/hard soled or similar type shoes when inside the property due to the soft floor coverings. • TURN OFF ITEMS WHEN NOT IN USE: Make sure all lights fans air conditioners heaters etc. are switched off when not in the property/in use. • VISITORS: We do not allow any visitors unless approved by management first. We need to know who is staying & visiting the property especially in case of an emergency. • UTILITIES AMENITIES & BUILDING/RENOVATION/NOISE DISRUPTIONS: Third-party services such as water gas electricity & internet and neighbour building/renovation works are beyond our control. Although our best efforts will be utilised to update you in a timely fashion assuming our company receives notice of the event or disruption in the event of service or noise interruption relating to these reasons that are beyond our control you agree that you are not entitled to nor will you seek compensation of any kind including partial refunds or complete refunds for any such interruption.

For all properties the noise level must be inaudible from neighbouring properties. Please be mindful of other residents in the building and refrain from making too much noise after 9pm. All guests are expected to behave in a manner that does not cause distress to neighbours or interfere in any way with their right to enjoy their properties. We reserve the right to remove guests who do not adhere to this code of behaviour. In these cases we will not be responsible for finding or funding alternate accommodation nor will we be responsible for any other associated costs. We have a ‘No-Party’ policy. Fines apply to any guest who disturbs neighbours with parties. Guests are required to enter and exit the property without disturbing other residents of the complex. Guests may not engage in any illegal activity at the property. Also smoking is strictly not allowed in the property hallways elevators or lobbies (where relevant). Fees will be charged to clean and deodorise the apartment due to smoke damage. If anyone is found on CCTV cameras (where relevant) to be smoking in any of the above areas the booking may be cancelled immediately. Footage can also be checked well after departure. Please don’t smoke inside the property or allow smoke to enter from outside. Please don’t leave your butts in the car park garden or courtyard area. Our apartments are non-smoking indoors. This includes smoking on balconies with the balcony doors open (where applicable). We reserve the right to terminate your stay if we become aware of guests or their friends smoking indoors. There may also be additional cleaning fees to remove any smoke fumes from the property. The number of guests staying at the property must not exceed the number agreed to in the booking details. If any additional persons stay at the property an additional fee may be charged. Rubbish: General During your stay we need you to dispose of your rubbish and recycling in the rubbish and recycling bins please. These are in the garage. Recycling There may be instructions on how to sort the recycling so please follow them. Plastic bags and plastic wrap are NOT recyclable so please leave all items you place in the recycling LOOSE and UNWRAPPED please. (Bags of recycling will not be recycled; so this defeats the point of putting items in the recycling bins). If pets are entering the property or staying at the property (only allowable for pet friendly properties) this must be disclosed at the time of booking or we reserve the right to terminate the booking. In that case we will not be responsible for finding or funding alternative accommodation. The general house rules for pet guests are to not allow them on the beds and furniture not to allow them to damage any property and to clean up after them before leaving the property. Guests will be liable for any necessary cleaning and dry-cleaning if required. Additionally the number of pet guests must be disclosed clearly at the time of booking. Please let us know if there have been any accidental breakages so we can replace the broken items. If you experience any maintenance or other issues during your stay please don’t wait to tell us. We can’t help you if you tell us about it after you leave. We would also like to know about it before your departure date anyway so we can get someone in straight away to try and fix it before the next guests arrive. Please leave the property in the state in which you found it on arrival. All breakages or losses must be reported immediately to us. Any damages or additional cleaning fees will be charged to you. It is our policy to have all locks changed if keys are lost or not returned. Similarly any remote controls will be replaced at your cost if lost or not returned. Guests are expected to leave the property in a neat and tidy state without the need for extensive excessive cleaning. You are responsible for all cleaning charges in the event that the property is left in a state that requires more than standard cleaning. Excessive use of electricity gas and any other utilities will be charged to you. Neither us nor the owners of the property are liable for loss to you of any personal belongings while you are in the property. Guest items found by our cleaning staff are kept in our office for one month before discarding. It is your responsibility to follow up any items that may have been left behind at the property. We request that guests send a reply-paid envelope to us in order for us to return the items. Plants: We love our plants and hope you do too. They require minimum attention but if you are staying for a long period please water every week in Summer and every two weeks in Winter – or when they look a little sad and droopy! A small watering can is located in the bathroom and under the sink downstairs and a large watering can is in the Euro laundry. The upper plants on the high wall near the front door can be watered from the master bedroom. The lower three plants can be watered by standing on the couch. All other plants in the hanging system are fake. Wi - Fi: Wi-Fi log-in details can be found on the modem. (Please note that you may need to pop the base off some modems to see this). It’s important that you don’t: Change any of the cables connected to the phone or the wall outlet Reset the Router Rangehood lights & switches: Pull the rangehood out horizontally to work the lights and switches for the rangehood. Fire Safety: A fire blanket and fire extinguisher are provided in your apartment. Please familiarise yourself with their locations. If you are in an apartment complex and happen to burn something in the kitchen and it fills with smoke DO NOT open the door to the hallway as this can set off the building’s fire alarms. In a false alarm situation the Fire Department charges heavy fines for the call out and these will be payable by you under the Owner’s Corporation Rules of the building. Turning on the aircon (on the high fan setting) the range hood fan on high the exhaust fans and opening all the windows is a much better option. Locked Out? We hope that it doesn’t happen to you but occasionally some guests find themselves locked out of the property. First point of contact: Our office on 0401 119 429 - call-out fee applies Second point of contact: Housekeeping team on 0411 629 541 - call-out fee applies. Third point of contact: our preferred locksmith Damian on 0411 493 550 – available 24 hours - fees apply directly to Damian. Lost Keys? Unfortunately replacing keys and locks is an expensive task. Any costs incurred to replace multiple sets of keys and their matching locks will be passed onto you. If you happen to take a set of keys with you by accident when you depart please notify us immediately and return them to us within 48 hours to avoid us having to replace the keys and locks. You should find all the manuals for all the electrical appliances throughout the property (including the stove air-con TV’s washing machine and kitchen appliances) in the bottom draw of the kitchen or in the back of the guest information folder. Security: Please ensure you lock all the doors and windows each time you exit the property. You should take care regarding security and for your own peace of mind. We advise keeping all doors to the property locked at all times. Heating and Cooling: This property has four reverse cycle aircon units that provide both heating and cooling. There is a remote control for this that you’ll need to use in order to turn the system on. The wall unit may display a light. Each unit has its own remote however if you use one for another just make sure you hit the on button twice. To change between heating and cooling: Most reverse-cycle units are similar and there may be slight differences at each property but they generally work as follows: Press the MODE button. The 'snowflake' symbol indicates cooling. The ‘sun’ symbol indicates heating. Don’t use the “AUTO” setting for the FAN or Mode Don't use the dehumidify (water drop) setting. Recommended temperatures: If you keep all the doors and windows closed the property will heat up or cool down fairly quickly even on a moderate temperature setting. You don’t need to set the temperature very high or low in order to achieve a comfortable temperature. The Department of Environment and Sustainability recommend you start the temperature at 20°C for both heating and cooling and adjust from there. Please turn things off when you’re out: If you’re going out please remember to turn off heating cooling lighting irons etc and turn off any large appliances (except fridges) at the wall if possible before you go. Important: Please never ever leave the property with the appliances washing machine or even the dishwasher running. These are fire hazards and we don’t want the place to burn down or you to be held responsible for it.

HouseRules1: Kitchen: There are instruction manuals for appliances in the drawers in the TV cabinet. Wipe your pots and pans with a paper towel before rinsing to help remove excess grease. Collect cooled oil and either put it in the bin or on your compost. Instead of rinsing scraps off your plate scrape them into the bin or compost. Using a sink strainer is another good way to reduce the risk of a blocked sink or sewer. Bathroom: The property manager has provided a set of towels for each guest to use inside the property. When you depart please place any used towels inside the bathtub. Hot Water System: Also please note the hot water system is quite small and although perfect for this apartment size please keep your showers to a reasonable time not overly long otherwise you might find yourself without hot water for a while (possibly even overnight) until it heats up. Toilet: All types of wipes do block sewers and should not be flushed down the toilet even "flushable wipes" cause blocked pipes pumps and sewers so place these items in the bin not your toilet. Please refrain from putting anything down the toilet which could lead to blocked and overflowing sewers. Safety Info/Rules: The property is located in a residential community and although this is a holiday destination it's home to many people. As such they ask that you respect their privacy and their right to a peaceful existence! Specifically between the hours of 11:00pm and 7:00am noise should be kept to a minimum. No parties. Breakages: The property manager understands that sometimes accidents happen! Should you break anything please let them know immediately. If it's a larger issue (e.g. the TV screen!) you will be charged. Smoking: This is a smoke-free home including the outside area surrounding property. No smoking of any substance including vaping. Pets: The home owner chooses to make their home pet-free due to many people being allergic. Please respect this policy. TV: You’ll find the remote control next to the television. You can also follow instructions to log into any streaming services by logging in. Please just remember to log out of your accounts before you head off. Rubbish: There are rubbish and recycle bins at the front of the house. For larger amounts we would appreciate if you could put it straight into the bin for smaller amounts the cleaners will fix this up at the end of your stay. Power Outage: Before calling your host or the below trades check the switch box at the property and make sure the fuse has not been tripped. Unplug all the appliances you have plugged in or switched on that may have caused the power to trip check the switchboard then plug them back in one by one to see if an appliance is causing the fault. If there is NO power at all there may be a suburb outage in this instance the property manager is unable to do anything until the local provider fixes the issue. Wi-fi: The property manager has provided this service for your enjoyment and convenience. However please note that you are responsible for its safe and appropriate use and compliance with all laws. If there is any loss of service please contact them. Check that the credentials have been entered in correctly. Check that all the lights are lighting up on the modem. If not please turn off at the PowerPoint and back of the modem for 5 minutes restart and check if all working again please be patient with this restart. If all of the above don't work please message the property manager from your phone for troubleshooting. Damages: Damages need to be reported ASAP with photos and as much information as possible. Please do not phone in unless it is an emergency. We prefer to come to a solution as quickly as possible we understand accidents do happen and we do assess all damages individually as a case-by-case situation. Please note that there is a period after departure where the property is inspected. Fees: Fees will apply for excess rubbish and lost keys. Please dispose of / take with you excess garbage any overflow of garbage left at the property will incur an immediate collection fee. Smoke Detectors: The property has smoke detectors fitted for your safety. Please note that if by any chance the smoke detectors go off in the flat because say someone has seriously burned the toast or charred the lamb roast they should on no account open the door to the hallway to clear the smoke because that could set off the sprinkler system for the whole floor.

Troubleshooting - Electricity: You will need to locate your trip switch and fuse box this will usually be close to your electricity meter. Modern electric circuits are fitted with a circuit breaker fuse system. If a fault develops a switch is tripped. If you have a trip switch. If a switch has tripped you should flick it back on and then re plug items one by one. If the switch trips again you will know that that particular item is faulty. Troubleshooting: Switch ON If a switch is on then turn it off and back on – the mechanism can trip inside the box but not move the actual switch. If this does not restore the supply then push the ‘push to test’ button. If the switch now trips it means you have a problem with your wiring or perhaps a faulty appliance as the this button can only trip the switch if you have a good electricity supply. The switch will now be in the off position. This is a problem within your home so do not call your supplier. You will need to call the property manager to arrange a qualified electrician to come out and fix the problem. If the switch is on and the ‘push to test’ button doesn’t trip the switch this means that there is no incoming electricity supply so you will need to call the property manager. Switch OFF If when you go to the box a trip switch is off then you should flick it back on. If it stays on but you still have no electricity then make sure you have not switched off the main fuse box switch. If the switch trips straight away then it means you have a problem with your wiring – you should call out a qualified electrician to look into this. If the fuse box and trip switch are separate then turn off the fuse box and turn the trip switch back on – it should stay on. If it flicks to off again then there is a fault with the fuse box or trip switch itself. As with handling any electrical equipment do not attempt to fix something if you are not confident of how it works of exactly what action you need to take. Report it straight away to the property manager. Troubleshooting - Water shut off valve: To shut off a faucet toilet or similar fixture first look for a stop valve that’s connected to the water supply tubes located directly under the fixture. This is normally a chrome-plated or plastic valve. Beneath a sink one serves hot water and one serves cold. To shut off a water heater turn off the cold water valve above the water heater. To shut off the water supply to a washing machine just turn off the valve behind the machine. Shut off water to the entire house If you don’t find a shutoff valve near a fixture you can shut off the valve that controls the flow of water to the entire house normally located near where the cold water pipe enters (the valve will be outside in warm climates inside in cold climates). Troubleshooting - Internet > Please switch off the router. > Disconnect all the cables. > Wait for 15 minutes. > Reconnect all the cables to the same positions. > Please switch on the router/NBN box. > Wait another minute. If the property has a dongle. If the Dongle is not working properly please follow the next steps: 1. Go to settings 2. Then go to more. 3. then you should be able to do a factory reset. Troubleshooting - Gas shut off valve: Warning: If the gas smell in your home is very strong it is best to leave the house immediately and call the property manager so they are able to contact the utility company to check out the problem. Understanding the danger of gas leaks the utility companies will make this emergency inspection quickly and will have special sensing equipment to pinpoint the cause of the problem. The danger of explosion is very real in a house where the gas smell has filled several rooms and you should leave immediately. If the odour of gas is faint though you can shut off the gas yourself before calling the utility company. Follow the below steps; *Make sure all the burner controls are in the off position. If this isn't the problem move to the next step. *Locate the gas valve handle and turn it a ¼ turn until it stops. When it is turned off the handle will be perpendicular to the path of the pipe. *Turn on one of the stove burners to verify that the gas is turned off. *Call the property manager to report and arrange a technician to attend and find the source of the problem. Troubleshooting - Washing Machine/Dryer: WASHING MACHINE: The washing machine and the dryer are in a foreign language. Check power is on & machine is plugged in. Machine isn’t overloaded. Load isn’t bunched to one side during spin cycle (generally towels). Water to machine is on Check drain pipe is connected to machine and leading into sink or pipe Check settings DRYER: The dryer is a condescending dryer the drawer needs emptying frequently. Check power is on & machine is plugged in Check door closes Check settings Location of garbage bins: are located at the front. Cooking: The cook top is gas. Hold down the igniter button and turn nob to light. Range hood: The range hood is located above the cooktop please turn it on when using the cooktop to minimise the possibility of triggering the smoke alarm. You can change the fan speed by using the buttons on the range hood. The Oven: The property is equipped with a Oven. The oven will not operate until all three settings are engaged temperature cooking style and timer. Please turn all nobs to off when cooking is complete. Use the control knobs to select features such as grill fan forced cooking timer switch etc. The oven should turn off automatically once the timer count down is complete. Remember to turn the oven off manually if the timer has not been used. Failure to turn oven off may result in the fire alarm being activated. Micrwave oven: Please do not use metal utensils including aluminium foil whilst using the microwave. Please place food in the microwave with the splash cover if required choose the desired setting – power time and press the start button. Please note that some Tupperware and plastic containers are not microwave safe - please look for the symbol enclosed if you are not sure prior to using them in microwave/dishwasher. Pot Plants The cactus plants in the apartment are all real and their thorns are very sharp. Please be careful when you are around them. Please be careful with small children so that they don’t hurt themselves. Please can you remember to water the indoor plants once a week and please put them in the sun for a few hours on the same day as you water them. We put a few ice blocks around the cactus and orchids when they look a little dry. This way they don’t get too much water and die. Please water the plants on the balcony in the cool of the morning or late evening so that they don’t burn in the hot sun. If you can remember it please feed the balcony plants with crystal fertilizer each fortnight and water them in. Thanks you for your help. Please do not leave rubbish in the apartment during the day especially in the warmer months. It begins to smell and attracts insects and cockroaches. Please do not try to force large bags of rubbish into the shute. It will get stuck and cause problems for all the neighbours. There is also a rubbish room located on level 6. Please adhere to the Rules & Regulations posted inside this area. Please be environmentally aware and sort your recycling correctly. Balcony Use Towels and other clothes must not be hung over the balcony rails and drying racks should be kept back from the front of the balconies so as to minimise the impact from the street. Every attempt should be made to minimise any objects being seen from the street. Nothing is permitted to be attached to the balustrades. Nothing is allowed to be fixed to o the external walls of the building as this will void the warrantee on our r render. No structures are to be erected on the balconies. It is up top of the cupboard. If you have any power issues please go to the fuse box and check to see if any of the switches are pointing down. If they are please flick the switch back up and then test your devises again. If you continue to have issues please contact the Guest relations Manager for assistance. Air Conditioning The apartment has fully ducted reverse cycle air conditioning installed. To operate the air conditioning go to the control panel on the wall just near the kitchen. - In the bottom left corner of the screen press the On button. - Press the arrows up or down to increase or decrease the temperature. - Please be aware that the air conditioning should not be set to anything less than 23C for the best operation of the unit. - The system has 2 zones. One for the bedrooms and the other for the living areas. - Choose from cool heat dry or auto - Please turn the AC off when you are not at home. Important – Please do not leave windows or doors open when the air conditioning is running. It causes the unit to over work. It cannot acclimatize and it can cause the unit to break down. Note - We hope you enjoy the air conditioning which has been added for your comfort. As a special request could you please set the temperature to 23 degrees and ensure the appliance is turned off when you leave the property for an extended period of time. Thank you for your assistance in this regard. Bedside Lamps The bedside lamps in the master bedroom are made of Egyptian Chrystal and are very expensive to replace. Please be careful not to break them. Intercom When you get a visitor to the building you need to let them in using the intercom system. The intercom will ring when they press the apartment number from down in the entry. You press the “Key” button which allows the front door to open and also enables the lift to bring your guest to level 6 only. Warning System The building is fitted with a built in emergency warning system. On a monthly basis the building manager will test the speakers and the system by running a siren. After the siren has been sounded they will announce that this is a warning. Laundry Located in the hall behind the second set of cupboard doors. E.g. grilling or roasting - Turn the right knob to select the cooking temperature - Press the OK button in the middle of the screen to start. The rules are as follows: - There is to be no smoking or drinking in any of the common areas of the building. - You may not hold any type of party or rowdy gathering. - If you do hold a party or rowdy gathering the neighbours will notify the property manager (they are owner occupiers and have an emergency party notification number). WIFI: If you’re having trouble with WIFI please follow these steps: - Restart your devices: Restart the modem and/or NBN connection box so they can reconnect. Remove the power cable from your modem for 10 seconds then plug it back in. Wait 1-2 minutes for the modem to settle and go ‘green’ now check to see if your devices are connecting. This is a ‘reboot’ and can often solve connection problems. If there is a cover on the NBN connection box you’ll need to remove that first. Wait at least two minutes before plugging the battery unit back in and turning your devices back on. - Check for WIFI issues. In case the issue is being caused by WIFI: Make sure your modem’s WIFI light is on. If it’s off press the Wi-Fi or WPS button to turn it back on. - Make sure the modem’s power light is on and your cables are securely connected. - Check your Ethernet cable is securely plugged into the yellow LAN port on your modem and the Ethernet port on your computer or device. - Check the status lights on your NBN connection box.

HouseRules1: All guests must abide by the Mornington Peninsula Shire’s Short Stay Rental Accommodation Local Law 2018. Under these local laws unacceptable behaviours include: Aggressive behaviour Yelling screaming and arguing Loud cheering clapping and singing Allocated parking must be used Additional accommodation is not allowed on site by way of tents caravans campervans or similar facilities. Outdoor areas including swimming pools spas outdoor decking and balconies are not to be used between 11:00pm and 7:00am. Please note this property has security cameras at the front of the property. These are monitored by our team for safety and security purposes. Linen and towels are provided for your stay. You will only need to BYO beach towels. We ask that once you choose a bed for your stay you do not move around. As if excessive linen is used for your stay for your group size we will have to pass on costs tor extra laundering. Bedding: Our team places freshly laundered sheets quilt covers and pillow cases on the beds for all stays. To use the washing machine first open lid and load dirty clothes in add washing liquid or powder in tray pictured below. Close lid. Push power button twist dial to desired wash type push temp button to desired temperature and push start to begin wash. Please report any breakages or damage to our team within 12 hours. We do not allow smoking in any of our properties. However you are welcome to smoke outside or on the balconies. Please use the ashtrays provided and not any of the crockery. Please do not throw cigarette butts over into the neighbours property either we work hard to maintain good relationships with them and this will not help us. Any guests that do smoke indoors will be charged for cleaners to return the property to the state it was in when you arrived Extra charges which may apply but are not limited to: Extra cleaning and/or putting away kitchen items Cleaning of BBQ Evidence of smoking inside property resulting in necessary fumigation Cigarette butt removal (indoor & outdoor) Evidence of a pet at a non-pet friendly property resulting in extra cleaning/fumigation Removal of any animal waste Removal of any animal hair at a Pet Friendly Property Loss of Keys — Cost plus maintenance charge Damages and/or Breakages Staying past confirmed check out time Removal of excess rubbish. Bins will not be collected if they are overflowing nor will bags be collected. Please take any excess with you or contact our office to arrange payment for removal. Emergency call out when it is of guests own fault Party fee: Please note that if you have a party or do not abide by noise restrictions you will be asked to leave immediately. You will also be charged a party fee fine due to after hours management and working this neighbours police and council.

HouseRules1: - No Events - We do not allow any visitors unless approved by management first. We need to know who is staying & visiting the property especially in case of an emergency. If you have additional guests to what your booking details state your booking may be cancelled immediately and you will be required to leave the premises. - When cooking in the kitchen please use the heat mats provided for the kitchen bench dining table and coffee table to place hot items on – do not place hot items directly on these surfaces. - We have a strict noise policy; quiet time is strictly from 10:00pm until 7:00am please be respectful of all residents who reside in the surrounding areas. If we receive any noise complaints for your property during these hours you will be required to leave the property immediately and your booking will be cancelled. - If you break or damage something during your stay please advise us as soon as practically possible so we can arrange for its replacement or repair promptly. Depending on severity and cost we reserve the right to charge you an applicable fee for reimbursement and/or compensation. - We do not tolerate drugs or illegal activity; in this instance your booking will be cancelled immediately and you will be removed from the property. - If any keys/remotes/fobs are lost during your stay - you will be liable for FULL replacement costs. - If you lock yourself out during your stay we will need to either arrange to meet you onsite to provide you with access or alternatively we’ll arrange for our locksmith. Call-out charges will occur due to the inconvenience and travel time caused by this issue. Our best endeavours will be used to arrange this immediately. - Third-party services such as water gas electricity & internet are beyond our control. Although our best efforts will be utilised to update you in a timely fashion in the event of service interruption beyond our control this may not always be possible or take time. - If maintenance arises during your stay please refer to our guest handbook for simple troubleshooting guides. If the issue persists you must contact us immediately to report any issues. Please provide us with a description of this issue and attach photos. Our best efforts will be utilised to update you and arrange for repairs or rectification. - We rely on the local council to dispose of the council bins on a weekly basis. All guests are responsible for maintaining the council bins and correctly dispose of their rubbish in accordance with the council guideline as outlined in the guest handbook and rubbish management plan. Do not leave rubbish in open areas. If there is overflow of rubbish at your check-out you will be charged a fee. - You should not disturb any common spaces outside the street or create a nuisance that disturbs the surrounding community. Failure to respect the neighbours property manager or community concerns will result in the immediate booking cancellation. - Extra charges will apply if the property is not left in an acceptable condition at check-out or if additional beds bedding or linen are used. - Please do not move any large furniture inside the property. Chairs and smaller furniture must be shifted back to their original location upon departure. - Please do not light candles or incense inside – it is a fire hazard. - All kitchen items you have used must be thoroughly washed dried and put away before departure. - Make sure all lights fans air conditioners heaters etc are switched off when not in the property/in use. - Drinks or food must not be consumed in the bedrooms. - Please take care when using our bed linen and towels if there are any stains a fee will be enforced to conduct heavy stain removal treatment or replacement. - Please refrain from wearing stilettos/studded/hard soled or similar type shoes when inside the property due to the soft floor coverings. - Please ensure you collect all belongings upon departure. - Upon departure please empty the fridge and pantry of opened/perishable food place all rubbish in bins ensure that the property is left neat and tidy all dishes to be washed & put away all lights & air con heaters to be switched OFF remove all personal effects and lock all doors to the property when you leave.

HouseRules1: Doors and Keys: You will be given an apartment front door key mailbox key and an access swipe. Use the access swipe for access to the building main entrance door for access to the gym Pool and to use the lift to your floor. The front doors to the apartment do not lock automatically you need to lock them with a key - please ensure you have apartment keys with you when you leave the apartment. There is an after hours call out fee for lockouts. Lost keys and security cards will incur a fee to replace. Should you lose your key or access swipe the property manager must be advised immediately to cancel access into the building and to order replacement cards and keys. Visitors: Visitors should call your apartment via the remote call panel by the left hand street level entrance to the Skye Building. Dial the apartment number and press the ‘bell’ symbol to call the intercom. When you answer the intercom and are happy that the visitor is genuine let them in by pressing the key button on the base which also allows the use of the lift to your floor. No Smoking: All apartments are strictly no smoking. Please refrain from smoking inside the apartment building. Inventory: The inventory report details all the furnishings crockery cutlery and other wares that are included in your apartment for a comfortable stay. Please check that the inventory is correct at the start of your stay as damages and discrepancies may result in a charge on departure. Dishwasher: Only use dishwashing powder. Only use half teaspoon of powder in the larger receptacle. Tall glasses and crockery on side shelves will not wash and may break. Do not stand anything high on the side shelves as this may prevent the dishwasher from sealing and so cause water to leak onto the electronics in the machine. The fitted draw machines have a remote control on/off attached on the right-hand side of the splash back. Garbage: Garbage disposal rooms are located to the left of the lifts. General waste must be placed in plastic bags and tied securely to prevent odours from escaping. These garbage bags must be placed into the chute and not in the recycling bins. Paper cardboard and glass plastic and cans can be placed in the recycling bins provided or take to the garbage room on level S accessed from the middle lift only use your apartment key to open the garbage room door. Please do not leave food scraps or rubbish lying about in your kitchen. Cockroaches will find it very quickly and are then very difficult to eradicate from your apartment. Electrics Panel: In the unlikely event of electricity failure please check the distribution panel first to check for a tripped switch this is located in the cupboard above the fridge. Cleaning: The apartment is cleaned once per week. The cleaners will change the bed linen and towels clean the kitchen bathroom dust and vacuum and wash the floor. Please make sure that any bags are off the floor to facilitate the cleaning. They don't do the washing up if there are dirty dishes please place them in the dishwasher. You will be notified of the normal cleaning day on check in. please let the property manager know if this is inconvenient. Laundry: The laundry includes a washing machine and dryer. Please clean the filter in the dryer after use especially if drying towels. Please do not hang clothes to dry on the balcony. Please turn on the extractor fan when using the laundry. Environmental Considerations: Please be mindful of wasteful use of energy and water. Please follow the below: - Turn off lights air conditioning or heaters when you leave the apartment. - Take measures to reduce water consumption. Smoke Detection: Smoke detector devices are fixed to the ceiling of your apartment. These devices will activate an audible alarm if smoke is detected in your apartment. Windows and Doors: Please keep windows and doors closed if you are out. Summer storms can start very quickly and violently. The wind that comes with them will damage the blinds. Please also be advised that you are responsible for paying for any repairs due to wind or rain damage if doors and/or windows are left open. Audio TV and DVD: The apartment has a TV and DVD player which also plays CDs. The apartment has a Google home from which you can ask questions such as how do I get to .. ask it to play radio stations from around the world. Set alarms. There is also a Google chrome device to play computer content. Fire Alarm and Exits: The property has an occupant warning system located in the car park. Fire engineers will test the alarm system from time to time. Emergency exits are clearly marked by green signs hanging from the ceilings in the hallways and evacuation plan is located next to the lift. Please familiarise yourself with the fire exits. In the event of an emergency follow the instructions of any authority. Exit the building following the ‘exit’ signs via the fire stairs. Emergency lighting will illuminate the emergency egress routes in the event of normal power failure. Do not use the lifts in emergencies. Maintenance: For any maintenance matters please call Liz Jeavons-Fellows on 0432 688 679. Insurance: You are required to insure your own contents. If the property manager is required to claim on their insurance for damage caused by you or your visitors you will be required to pay any excess charges. Damages: Please notify the property manager of any damages or breakages. Acceptance of the Terms and Conditions includes agreement to payment for any damage breakages or loss of any furniture fittings and/or equipment to the property its common areas and/or its contents and agrees to provide credit card details as payment for any such occurrence. This includes wind and or rain damage if doors or windows are left open. Other: The property manager and staff may check the apartment from time to time or give access for routine maintenance inspections e.g. fire alarms.

HouseRules1: We supply just one set of keys the keys safe code will apply for your entire stay we recommend that you put the keys back in the safe and give the code to all of the guests staying at the property then you can all come and go as you please and the property can be easily secured during your stay. The property must not be used by more than the number of guests booked and paid for on your reservation either visiting or staying at the property without written approval. Smoking is not permitted anywhere inside a property. No commercial activity is to take place at the property. Tents caravans and other structures are not to be erected or occupied at the property at any time including inflatable pools. Guests should be aware that all inbound and outbound calls to (02) 4862 5200 are recorded. You must take any excess rubbish with you that does not fit in the provided bins when you leave. If it is bin night during your stay or the day of your departure you are required to put the bins out on the kerb. You will find a bin night notification at the property. You will be charged a tipping fee if excess rubbish is left at the property or if the garbage bin is not put out on bin night as requested. The property is a privately-owned home and we enforce a ‘Good Neighbour Policy’. Please treat the property with the same care you would use with your own residence and leave it in the same condition it was in when you arrived. Under no circumstances are the following activities permitted: motorbikes; dirt bikes; quad bikes; use of firearms; air rifles; fireworks or any fire related activities other than those that are fixtures at the property. A $1000 fine plus costs to remediate will be payable if a guest or visitor to the property is in breach of this term. To prevent theft of or damage to furnishings or your personal belongings you agree to close and lock doors and windows when you are not present at the property and upon check out. Should you not be able to secure the property you must contact us or the host on the number provided to you immediately. If the property has a key safe you must use it during your stay. Cleaning is included in the full tariff however if excessive cleaning is required the guest will be charged at cost. A $50 cleaning fee will be charged for unclean BBQs. Guests can decide to clean the BBQ to avoid the charge. If the BBQ is not cleaned to a high standard the credit card will be charged $50. Each holiday property is equipped for a specific number of guests. No mattresses tents caravans or more cars than the property accommodates are allowed. It is against Health Department Regulations for more persons to occupy a property than there are beds to accommodate them. The guest limits apply for the duration of the booking. Any extra guests (this includes day visitors) above those that have been booked and paid for must be approved in writing prior to the stay. The owner has the right to charge for extra guests/visitors and/or to decline any request. Any unapproved excess guests/visitors may result in a party/function/extra guests fine of $1000 registration with industry exclusion registers and/or traveller reviews on booking sites. When a property has Wi-Fi Netflix Foxtel or other streaming services which offer pay per purchase programs any purchase must be paid for by the guest in advance. No responsibility will be taken for children or pets staying at or visiting the property. Please supervise carefully always taking into consideration fencing pools dams stairs verandahs balconies and cleaning chemicals. Children under the age of 10 years old must not sleep on the top bed of a bunk. 9 months and under are classed as infants. If you encounter an issue before during or after the stay you must contact us or the host on the number provided to you immediately so that we can attempt to fix it. We will not be able to consider compensation unless we have been afforded the opportunity to remedy any issue. We will do our best to provide attention for any issue but cannot guarantee a fix. Should the host a tradesperson or a representative from our team be called to the property and the issue is deemed to be caused by a guest equipment owned by a guest or because a guest has not followed instructions provided at the property or via phone the guest will be responsible for payment of the invoice for the tradesperson and the call out fee of $110.00 at the time of the callout. Smoking is not permitted inside any of our properties. If you need to smoke you must do so away from the property to ensure that the smoke does not enter the property. If evidence of smoking inside the property is detected you will be charged for steam cleaning of carpets and furniture laundering of all soft furnishings and linens plus replacement of linen where necessary. Many rural properties do not allow smoking at all due to bushfire risk. It is the guest’s responsibility to understand this prior to booking.

HouseRules1: SECURITY CAMERAS: This property has security cameras to the external areas which management checks regularly at all hours. If these are tampered with in any way your booking will be cancelled you will be asked to leave and no refunds will be issued. NOISE MONITORING DEVICE: This property has a noise monitoring device that management checks regularly at all hours. If this device is disconnected during your stay we will be notified of this disconnection and you will be at risk of having your booking cancelled immediately. KITCHEN MATS: When cooking in the kitchen please use the heat mats provided for the kitchen bench dining table and coffee table to place hot items on – do not place hot items directly on these surfaces. NOISE POLICY: We have a strict noise policy; quiet time is strictly from 10:00pm until 7:00am please be respectful of all residents who reside in the surrounding areas. If we receive any noise complaints for your property during these hours you will be required to leave the property immediately and your booking will be cancelled. RUBBISH DISPOSAL: We rely on the local council to dispose of the council bins on a weekly basis. Housekeeping do not remove rubbish from bins due to health and hygiene concerns. All guests are responsible for maintaining the council bins and correctly dispose of their rubbish in accordance with the council guideline as outlined in the guest handbook and rubbish management plan. Do not leave rubbish in open areas. If there is overflow of rubbish at your check-out you will be charged a disposal fee. CHECK-OUT PROCEDURE: Please empty the fridge and pantry of opened/perishable food place all rubbish in bins ensure that the property is left neat and tidy all dishes to be washed & put away all lights & air con heaters to be switched OFF remove all personal effects and lock all doors to the property when you leave. DAMAGES: If you break or damage something during your stay please advise us as soon as practically possible so we can arrange for its replacement or repair promptly. Depending on severity and cost we reserve the right to charge you an applicable fee for reimbursement and/or compensation. ILLEGAL ACTIVITY: We do not tolerate drugs or illegal activity; in this instance your booking will be cancelled immediately reported to Airbnb and you will be removed from the property. No refunds will be issued. PARKING: Please ensure you only park vehicles in the designated parking areas. There is strictly no street parking. SMOKING ALLOWED OUTSIDE ONLY: Smoking is allowed in outdoor areas only. Cigarette butts are to be extinguished and disposed of in the provided external bins. If the property smells like cigarette smoke upon checkout or cigarette butts have been found inside you will be charged a deodorising fee. LOSS OF KEYS/REMOTES/FOBS: If any keys/remotes/fobs are lost during your stay - you will be liable for FULL replacement costs. CANDLES/INCENSE: Please do not light candles or incense inside – it is a fire hazard.

HouseRules1: Noise Complaints: If a complaint of excessive noise or anti-social behaviour is received security will be dispatched to investigate and may result in a call-out charge. A report will be received by the property managers office with information as to whether a fee has been charged. At the time the report is received the property manager will also determine the severity of the incident and the impact on the property the community and the surrounding guests and residents. If the incident and impact is deemed to be severe all guests at the premises may be evicted from the premises. This determination is at the sole discretion of management and is non-negotiable. Guests must abide by their responsibilities and obligations under the NSW Fair Trading Code of Conduct for the Short Term Rental Accommodation Industry. You agree to fully comply with your obligations under State Legislation and Local law including the NSW Code of Conduct and do all things reasonably necessary to assist the property manager and/or the owners of the properties to comply with their obligations under the Code including the Exclusion Register. Privacy: If the accommodation is fitted with external video surveillance systems for security and protection of the accommodation and its occupants you consent to the use of these during your stay. The installation and use of security cameras has the express consent of the property owners. Linen: Linen and towels are provided unless otherwise notified. Beach towels are not provided. Keys: As there is a key-safe at the property please use it to secure one set of keys at all times when you leave the property including when you check out. If a tradesman needs to attend to any requested or agreed maintenance during your stay this will ensure they can access the property. If replacement keys or remote controls need to be cut or purchased key barrels need to be replaced or in secure complexes re-keying is required costs will be calculated based accordingly and charged to the guest. Damages: In the event of breakages damages and lost items the property manager requests that guests contact the office to report the incident as soon as possible. Movement of Items Within/Between Properties The property manager has a strict policy on moving items or furniture (indoor and/or outdoor) within a property or in the case of bookings across multiple properties from house to house. Movements may cause unnecessary damage to items and/or to the property and can cause excess cleaning time due to increased housekeeping inventory checks replacement of items. Any damages/excess cleaning caused by movement of items or furniture will be charged. Rubbish: The property manager requests guests put all rubbish in the appropriate bins provided outside no later than the night before collection (rubbish collection day is indicated in the property compendium). Please ensure the rubbish is put out at a reasonable hour so as not to cause noise and disrupt the neighbourhood (e.g. with recycling bottles). The bin lids must be able to close for the collection. If the bins are not put out or if there is excess rubbish upon check out a private contractor will be organised to empty the bins and charges will be charged. Pets: Guests must ensure their pet: • Is groomed to avoid excessive moulting • Is cleaned prior to entering the house to avoid marks to the property • Has had up to date worming flea treatments and vaccinations • Has had nails trimmed to avoid scratches to the floors and furnishings • Does not jump up on beds furniture or rugs (indoors or outdoors) • Is not left unattended as excessive barking may result in complaints from neighbours. If noise complaints are received and the pet cannot be quieted guests will be required to remove the pet from the property at their own expense. Additional cleaning charges may apply should pet hair urine fleas or any evidence (including smell) of the pet be left behind when guests leave. It is advised for pets to wear tick/flea collars to avoid bringing or picking up ticks/fleas to/from the area. Although the property manager do their best to ensure everything at the property is as it should be sometimes we aren't informed of missing items broken appliances etc. Please let us know as soon as you become aware of any issues so we can promptly address repair/replacement. There is a strict no party no excessive external noise policy. The property is designed for peaceful relaxation and you are in a residential area. If you are on the deck patio or hot tub please ensure you keep the noise to a minimum. Strictly from 10:00pm you must not be outside disturbing the neighbours. Please move inside from 10:00pm with the doors closed. The property manager requests guests to leave the property as it was found to avoid extra cleaning charges. This includes washing dishes placement of all rubbish in the large outdoor bins provided and cleaning of the BBQ.

A strict no-party policy applies please adhere to these rules. Per 18 Dec 2020 Fair-trading NSW requires guests to comply with the "No Noise" NSW State Government code of conduct in holiday houses and short term rental properties. Under the code guests are not allowed to damage the premises or make noise that 'unreasonably disrupts neighbours'. If these rules are not met you could face warning notices fines and being added to the exclusion register - where you are banned from booking short-term rentals for five years. The exclusion register is based on a 'two strikes and you are out' policy for disrespectful guests. No liability is accepted by the agent or property owner for any injury debt damage loss delay or inconvenience caused by events outside the agent or owners’ control. No responsibility is taken for guest’s personal property left behind at the premises. We will endeavor to return these items if found at the guests’ expense. Low value items found will be held for claiming for a maximum of 2 weeks. BBQ & GAS: All BBQ’s are to be cleaned on departure. If you arrive to find them dirty please notify staff ASAP. Holiday tenants failing to abide by this term may be responsible for the cost of cleaning all carpets furnishings and window coverings. CLEANING: You are required to leave the premises clean and tidy. Please ensure the kitchen and bathroom benches floors are left clean washing up done and put away and all garbage placed in the correct external bin otherwise cleaning/rubbish removal fees will be charged. NOISE COMPLAINTS and DISRUPTIVE BEHAVIOUR: Tenants should make every possible effort to ensure that they do not interfere or cause a nuisance to neighbors. Excessive noise and partying will not be tolerated. Loud music televisions and noise will not be permitted between 9pm and 7am. FUNCTIONS: No functions are to be held at any of our holiday properties including wedding events or parties without consent from our agency and the owner of the property. There is a no glass policy in the pool area. If broken glass is found in or around pool area to drain clean and refill the pool will be charged at $2000. Laundry/Cleaning/Dishwasher: There is a washing machine and dryer available for use. Please ensure to turn on the machine then use open door button to load machines. Washing machine has a great ‘quick cycles setting – 30 minute wash’ and the dryer filter and water draw must be empty after each load. There is a clothes drying rack available to utilise Queensland great sunshine. The dishwasher has a quick wash program 4 which provides an excellent clean. Please ensure all items are pre- rinsed before loading. A red light appears on the floor when working and door opens on completion. Please do not place cutting knife set in the dishwasher as this will dull the blades. BBQ and Kitchen A BBQ is available BBQ plate to be cleaned on completion of stay. If not an extra cleaning charge will incur of $50. I have provided a cleaning kit and ask that you take care not to scratch the inside sink with the hot plates. Additional kitchen items at the property to make your stay easier: microwave toaster toasted sandwich maker. Please use place mats on inside timber table and always use cutting boards on kitchen benches. Music - to Sonos Stereo speakers in Main Living Room Connect to Wifi on your phone Download “Sonos S1” app (either IOS or Android version) Open Sonos app. (there is no need to setup an account). Go to “Rooms” on bottom of screen – Select Living Room Go to “Browse” on bottom of screen – Select music service (options include Sonos radio Amazon Apple Spotify etc. Printing/Copying/Scanning - via HP Deskjet 2720e printer in office: Connect to Wifi on your phone or laptop Download HP Smart app (either IOS or Android or Windows) Open HP Smart app (there is no need to setup an account) If printer doesn’t appear automatically go to “Settings” at bottom of screen – Select “Printers – Add” Select HP deskjet 2700 Series [1723C9]. You should now be able to print and scan documents using buttons on main menu. After scanning the document can be saved as a PDF or JGP file on your phone or laptop and can be shared/emailed etc. Nothing is stored on the printer. Please don’t abuse the printing facility – it is provided free of charge for your benefit in case you need to print tickets scan documents etc. Air conditioning There are air conditioners in the main living master bedroom and front family room/office. Suggested cooling temperature 25 degC Suggested heating temperature 20 degC. PLEASE: Do not leave air conditioners on when you are out. Do not leave air conditioner on in unoccupied rooms Close doors on unoccupied rooms so main living air conditioner is not trying to cool/heat the whole house Close glass sliding doors and windows when using the air conditioning. Coffee Machine Press to start press again to stop – say 15 sec. Check container has water – lift off and refill if required. Check Power switch at wall is connected and ON Turn machine on using circular button on top of machine. The light will flash and then become steady when ready Lift silver handle insert pod pull handle down to pierce pod Place cup under spout (remove drip tray for larger mugs) Press button on top of machine to start dispensing Press button again to stop (approx. 15 sec for expresso) Lift handle to eject pod & repeat steps 4 to 7 for next coffee Standby mode is entered after 9 minutes – Press to turn on Tips: Standby is entered after 9 minutes – Press to turn on Preheat cup by with hot water first (without capsule) Do not reuse capsules NEVER insert 2 capsules. Fast blinking of light indicates capsule drawer is full. Milk Frother Don’t fill more than half way – it tends to overflow! (and putting the lid on wont stop it from doing so). Press button on front to start & stop Frother will stop automatically when milk is hot – BUT this may be too late to have prevented overflow or milk froth disappearing due to overheating. Best option is to stop frother manually when froth looks good then to finish heating in microwave. Please rinse frother after use Oven & Induction Cooktop Turn ON power switch located on LHS behind cooktop. Oven Set LHS knob (timer) to manual (11o’clock wavy lines) Use RHS knob to select function (fan forced etc) Select temperature with centre knob Cooktop Switch on using power button (bottom RHS) Place pan on desired element Select desired element then press UP/DOWN arrows to increase /decrease heat. When the pan is removed power will stop however the element and cooktop power MUST still be turned off The glass remains hot for a period after the pan is removed (indicated by “H”). Do NOT wipe glass while Hot Fridge Water & Ice Dispenser Fill up inside the Fridge.

HouseRules1: PET RULES: The animal must not cause a nuisance to or disturb any other Owner or Occupier; • The animal must be kept within the confines of the lot and is not permitted onto Common Property (with the exception of when the animal is required to enter and/or exit the scheme); • When entering and/or exiting the scheme the animal must be restrained such as via a leash or in a carry bag; • The animal must not be permitted to urinate or defecate on Common Property; • In the event that the animal accidentally urinates or defecates on common property the owner assumes responsibility of ensuring it is suitably cleaned up within a reasonable timeframe; • The animal must be kept clean & free of vermin; • A photo of the animal must be provided to the Body Corporate and to the building manager (if applicable); • If required by law the animal must be registered with Council and must wear an appropriate identification tag; • The animal must be of a size and nature that the animal can be controlled by the Owner or Occupier when the animal is within the confines of the lot and/or on Common Property and must not present a danger to others if the animal escapes from the Owner’s or Occupier’s control; • The Owner or Occupier shall be responsible for the cost of repairing damage to the common property or the property of Owners or Occupiers of other Lots caused by the pet; • Any consent granted will only apply to the particular animal and will not cover any replacement or additional animal; • The total number of pets within the lot must not exceed council regulations; • The Owner or Occupier acknowledges and adheres to all relevant by-laws of the scheme • Should the Body Corporate receive three (3) substantiated complaints in regard to the keeping of the pet within a three-month period the Body Corporate may withdraw the approval for the pet(s) and the owner shall remove the pet from the scheme land within 30 days of receiving a notice to do so from Body Corporate
