HouseRules1: We manage this apartment privately. On-site management will not be able to help you. Any questions just send them a message on the contact number above. I tend to leave guests to their own devices and enjoy the property without bothering them but feel free to contact us anytime. The front door locks from the inside when you walk in. You need the keys every time you go out (If we need to come and let you in because you have left the keys inside a call out fee will apply). There is only 1 guest set of keys for you to use. You can also use the lockbox. The keys are expensive if lost/not left on departure you will be charged a fee. You will find everything you need but if there is something that you require please contact us on 07 3358 2000. Kitchen: • The top drawer does not open (it’s decorative) • The cooktop is electric and there is a switch to the left of the cooktop that needs to be on for power. • The extractor fan turns on using the switches for light and fan at the front of it. • The microwave is a convection microwave oven. • Modem - - Is above the microwave just don’t unplug it. - Let us know if any ongoing internet issues. • Washing machine - - There’s a clothes airer on the balcony. - The building by-laws prohibit putting washing on the balcony so just put it inside in front of the glass sliding doors. • Safety Switches - - Far right cupboard nearest the front door. - Only if the power goes out. Please let us know if any issues. Living: • Air-Con - - There’s a remote for this should be on the coffee table. - Please please lease turn off the air-con when you are not here! • Smart TV - - Press the home icon and then choose what you want to watch. - If you don’t have a Netflix (or other streaming accounts) you can sign up to them for the free 30-day trial and cancel if you don’t want it after you leave. Bathroom: • Under the bathroom sink is a hairdryer. Bedroom: • The TV In the bedroom is Free2air only (no streaming). • The fan / light must have the wall switch turned on for it to have power and work. • You can use the remote for the aircon or turn on the unit itself. • Best to close the blinds when not using them as the bedroom can heat with sun. • In the closet is the iron and bed-side ironing board. Balcony: • Just be wary of noise outside as it travels. • The light switch is on the inside wall near the couch. • The seating area is for this apartment only and a reminder there is no smoking including out here. You’ll need to go onto the street if you have the need (Fines will be charged if you do not comply with these rules). Sauna Spa Gym and BBQ: • These facilities are on the 7th floor. • There are 2 pool towels in the bedroom closet please use these instead of bath towels as the water bleaches the towels. • Please be considerate of residents and hotel guests. Rubbish and Recycling: • The Rubbish bins are in the upper carpark across from the hotel entrance. • Out the front door straight ahead up the stairs and left at the end of that carpark. • Please take out your rubbish when you depart. Building Rules and Policy: • Although we manage this apartment privately the building rules and policy still apply. • These rules and policy can be seen in the common areas (e.g. no smoking in the building please be quiet when entering / exiting the building). • This can result in eviction with security attending for serious breaches of their rules.

HouseRules1: This property like many others is located in a residential area and therefore we request that you be respectful of neighbours by keeping noise levels down and supervising children in outdoor areas such as pools. Music and other loud noise on balconies beach fronts in pools and outdoor alfresco areas can be disruptive to neighbours and we request that these be restricted to indoors after 8.00pm and please remember that noise carries over water. As there is a neighbour very close by it is imperative that any pool and outside areas only be utilised between 8.00am and 8.00pm daily. The Code of Conduct for Guest Behaviour in Short term Holiday properties is shown below: The Code of Conduct Vehicles used by an occupant must; 1. Be stored to not cause a nuisance or inconvenience to adjoining premises 2. Be parked within parking facilities on the premises where provided. Use of the premises including any outdoor area of the premises for example an outdoor entertainment area deck balcony swimming pool or spa must not; 1. Detrimentally affect the residential amenity (including but not limited to noise overlooking or light-spill) enjoyed by residents adjoining or in the vicinity of the premises or 2. Cause a nuisance (including a noise nuisance) or 3. Display unacceptable behaviour (for example loud aggressive behaviour; yelling screaming arguing; excessively loud cheering clapping or singing; 4. Create a level of noise which is in excess of the acceptable levels described by Queensland Government legislation for environmental protection (noise). An occupant of the premises must not sleep or camp on the premises in a tent caravan campervan or similar facility. Pets occupying the premises must be managed and not cause a nuisance (including a noise nuisance). Each occupant of the premises must store general waste (including the separation of recyclable waste) produced as a result of the ordinary use or occupation of the premises in a waste container; must be placed in a waste container. Each occupant of the premises must ensure that the premises including the grounds of the premises are kept in a safe and tidy condition. Departure check out information can be found in the compendium at the house including the arrangements regarding the keys. The property must be secured all windows and doors shut on departure. Please make sure all the air conditioners fans and lights are turned off.

THE FOLLOWING INSTRUCTIONS ONLY APPLY IF YOU SHOULD HAPPEN TO RUN OUT OF HOT WATER: As there is no gas supply on Phillip Island most hot water systems are electric. As such they heat overnight and are at their maximum heat first thing in the morning. As much of the hot water is used for showers in the morning the water cools during the day and is likely to be cold by nightfall. To avoid this dilemma each hot water service is equipped with a "Boost" button. This button will be found on the electricity meter which is located in the meter box on the outside of the property. We recommend that you push this button before leaving in the morning. That way when you return in the afternoon or evening the water will be hot once again.

HouseRules1: Hydronic Heating: The hydronic heating will be switched off on arrival. To turn it on the thermostat is located in the lounge room. Switch it from off to manual. The temp can then be set we find around 18 degrees to be very comfortable and the house can warms up pretty quick. Hydronic panels are in every room and can be turned on off in different zones. If the hydronic can please be switched to the off position at the thermostat when you leave. Reverse Cycle Air Conditioner: The reverse cycle air conditioner is located in the dining area. This is good for heating or cooling the dining / kitchen and living but not the bedrooms. The remote is located in the kitchen and is attached to the splash-back. Point the remote at the unit to turn on and off. Scroll through the mode to the sun icon for heating and the snow icon for cooling. The temp can then be adjusted with the up and down temp buttons. Please ensure the unit is turned off when not needed and when you leave. Nespresso Coffee machine: Turn the machine on by either holding down one of the three buttons at the top of the machine for three seconds until the lights flash or by sliding the pod opening back. Once the machine is on it will take a minute or two to heat up and solid green light on top of the machine indicates it is ready for use. Make sure water is in the canister to the side of the machine and properly fitted. Choose one of the three circles at the top of the machine small circle is small shot of coffee medium circle is medium shot and biggest circle is a larger shot. Open up the pod opening on the machine if not already open and drop pod in. Slide pod opening closed and the machine will commence coffee extraction into you cup below. Rubbish Bins: We have two rubbish bins on the veranda. The maroon bin is general waste and the yellow lid bin is recycling. Both bins are collected Monday morning If you can please put the bins out on the street (in front of the tree) on Sunday afternoon/evening. Other: there are 2 areas of the house that cannot be accessed. The first is the wardrobes in the master bedroom and second is the garden shed. Both have locks on them. - The fireplaces in the bedrooms are ornamental only and the chimney is blocked so can’t be used. - the European laundry is behind the door in the dining room. - the door to the courtyard requires the door to be firmly pushed to the left to unlock and lock the door Checkout: Check out is 10am unless otherwise agreed prior. Please place all used towels in the bathroom for cleaning. Please ensure all lights and appliances are off when you leave. Particularly hydronic heating air con gas stove and oven. Please lock the doors when you leave and place the key back in the key safe.

TV: There is one smart remote to operate the TV. The remote has a red symbol in the top left corner this will turn the tv on and off. When turning on the TV the main way to navigate between the different options (free to air and the applications) is through the home button that has a house symbol located top right of the main selection button. To select between different applications simply scroll along the bottom row and press the middle button to select as well as there being Netflix Youtube Prime video and google play buttons underneath the main selection buttons. Please also note the property manager does not provide any Netflix or other accounts you will need to log into your own accounts for use. Please always remember to log out on departure. The property manager is not responsible for any additional bills or payments made on your account if you forget to log out. Oven: The knob on the far left is to set the oven to the setting in which you wish to cook. For example fan force grill oven grill bake etc. The knob on the far right is for setting the temperature of the oven. Your temperature will be displayed on the screen simply move the knob right to increase temperature and left to decrease. Stove: In order to use this simply hold the knob down and turn to the left to get the desired heat level you are after. Once done please make sure the knob is back to the right as far as possible to make sure gas doesn’t leak. Heating and Cooling: The property is equipped with a power ducted system ensuring optimal heating and cooling throughout the year. Conveniently located on the left wall at the top of the stairs the switch for the system is easily accessible. Operating the system is straightforward: Press the bottom right switch to activate the system; a green LED will illuminate and the screen will light up. The screen should display the set temperature in the middle. If not press the top right button until it appears. Adjust the temperature using the up and down arrows in the middle of the system. The set temperature will be displayed in the centre of the screen. Change the mode by using the left arrow then select the desired mode using the up and down buttons until it appears on the left side of the screen. They kindly request that you turn off the ducted system when leaving the property for extended periods. For heating the recommended setting temperature is between 22-23 degrees and for cooling between 18-20 degrees ensuring your utmost comfort year-round. Piano: The piano is at your disposal for enjoyment. Kindly treat it with care and refrain from placing drinks on it while in use. Cinema Room: The home features a home there complete with a large screen as well as a full working surround sound system. In their cinema room you'll find two - tier recliner chairs. For safety please ensure the chair is fully closed when leaving to prevent any potential injury. Light Bulb and Batteries: Spare light bulbs and batteries are available in the top drawer of the island bench-top for your convenience. If you notice the light bulbs or batteries running low kindly inform the property manager. Dishwasher: The home is equipped with a dishwasher. Kindly ensure all dishes and kitchen items are loaded into the dishwasher before your departure. Operating instructions for the dishwasher are as follows: To activate the dishwasher simply open the door and locate the on and off button on the left side of the top panel. Press this button to switch on the dishwasher. After loading your dishes close the dishwasher door securely. On the front panel there are four buttons. Press the top left button repeatedly until the LED indicator for your desired mode is illuminated. They recommend using the "30min 60" cycle before departure to assist their housekeeping and styling team. To start the dishwasher press the start button located on the bottom left of the front panel. Coffee Machine: When using the Nespresso machine please ensure the machine has adequate water and is turned on at the powerpoint. There are buttons to make different sized coffees on the top of the machine. After turning the machine on these buttons will flash until the machine is ready for use. When ready place the pod in the machine and pull the silver latch down. Then press the button corresponding to your desired size of coffee. Please regularly empty out the discarded pods from the machine. Rumpus Room: TV - To turn the TV on please press the red power button located on the top left of the remote. The TV comes with a dedicated ‘YouTube & Netflix’ button. Pressing these will take you directly to the application. They do not provide a Netflix account so if you do use your own account please remember to sign out once you leave the property. Bins and Garbage Disposal: The bins are located on the right-side of the property facing it from the driveway. The yellow bin is designated for recycling while the red bin is for general rubbish. Please ensure you use the correct bins for the corresponding materials. Bins are scheduled for collection on Tuesday mornings. If you're staying on a Monday night kindly place the bins out on Monday evening. If your stay includes a Tuesday night please retrieve the bins from the street. If you're checking out on Tuesday the housekeeping and styling team will handle bin collection for you. Failure to follow bin instructions including placement on the correct night may result in a surcharge deducted from the bond. Fans: Some of the bedrooms are equipped with easy-to-operate fans controlled by a white remote. To start the fan simply press any button on the remote. Adjust the fan speed by choosing one of the three modes provided such as low medium and high. The timer mode which you can set up up to six hours and the light button. Gas BBQ: Our Gas BBQ is conveniently situated in the outdoor entertaining area adjacent to the dining space. They provide a gas bottle that will remain connected throughout your stay with a spare located on the left side of the home should you need to switch it over. Should you replace the gas kindly inform the property manager so they can ensure a smooth transition upon your departure. They kindly request that you clean the BBQ before your departure. Failure to do so will result in an additional fees deducted from the bond. Fuse Box: The fuse box for this property is located on the right hand side of the property (facing the house). In the case of a complete or partial power outage please check the fuse box: If any switches are flipped into the ‘off’ position flip them back to an ‘on’ position. If all switches are on and no changes occur then this is most likely an issue with the power supply. Unfortunately there is nothing the property manager can do to rectify external power shortages. Laundry: The home comes with a front loader washing machine for you to use throughout your stay. - Open the drawer located on the far left and insert the washing powder or detergent into the left tray and close. - Use the middle knob to choose your option for the cycle. - The option you choose will show up on the digital screen. - On the screen you can see different options for the cycle you have selected including wash temp water level and spin speed. - Place the washing detergent into the container on the left. - Press the button START on the screen to begin the cycle. - After use make sure the knob is turned back to the upper middle for ‘OFF’. Dryer: - To start the cycle simply press the start/pause button located at the left side of the knob. - To power on the machine simply twist the knob in the middle. This also serves as the programs option therefore twist to your desired drying program. - To start the cycle simply press the play/pause button located at the far right hand side. Hot Tub: In the outdoor patio adjacent to the rumpus room you'll find a hot tub for your relaxation. To use the hot tub: - Remove the spa cover by holding the straps and folding it over itself (this requires two people). - Lean the cover against the deck wall. - Control the temperature using the spa controls. - Please remember to return the cover once you're finished. Important notes: - When the hot tub is not in use please keep the cover on. - Avoid putting your head underwater. - Tie back long hair. - Ensure children are supervised at all times.

Our Private Security team will secure the premises safeguard from damage and remain indefinitely or until the property is secure (this is at the Security/Caretakers discretion). The Police will also be called and if Councils are alerted further fines to you may arise. By agreeing to these Terms and Conditions below you agree to this procedure and all costs being as set out in clause 13. As explained above this costly zero tolerance approach is necessary to protect our homes.

CheckOutInstructions: Checkout Procedures: Standard checkout time is 10:00am on the morning of your departure date specified on your booking confirmation. We will email you checkout instructions a day before your departure. Please read through the instructions carefully as they will provide you with details on what to do with the apartment keys upon checkout. Please be mindful to leave the home in a neat and tidy condition as extra cleaning and excess rubbish removal will result in additional fees. On the day of your checkout the property manager would really appreciate it if you could: ● Place all dirty dishware and cutlery into the dishwasher and start a wash cycle. ● Remove all rubbish from the apartment and dispose in designated garbage area. ● Pack all your belongings and check all the drawers and cupboards. ● Ensure all the windows are closed and appliances are turned off. ● There is no need for you to wash the bed linens and towels as they will be sent to the property manager's professional laundry service provider after your stay.

HouseRules1: Intercom: You can provide your visitors with access to the building from within the apartment by using the intercom. Press the button on the intercom handset which will release the main entrance allowing the visitor entry to the lobby. Your visitor can then proceed to the elevator and continue to the door where the apartment is located. Internet: The modem is located inside the bedroom wardrobe. If you are experiencing difficulties with the Internet unplug the modem’s power cable from the outlet and leave it disconnected for 2 minutes. After 2 minutes reconnect the power and wait for the lights on the modem to turn green and try to reconnect to the Wi-Fi on your devices. If you are still experiencing issues please contact the property manager. Please DO NOT reset the modem. Television: All apartments contain TVs with access to all your personal streaming services. Simply select the Netflix or YouTube button on the TV remote and log in using your personal account details. To watch free to air channels press the source/Input button on the remote and change the source to DTV. Fire Safety and Awareness: Each apartment is fitted with smoke detectors fire extinguisher and blanket. In case of a fire please do not use the elevator and proceed to the nearest fire escape which is clearly indicated with exit signage in accordance with all building standards and statutory requirements. Air Conditioning: The air conditioner is controlled by the Daikin remote located on the wall. Press the Power button to turn on then use the corresponding buttons to adjust the temperature. For more heating and cooling functions slide the cover off the lower half of the remote to reveal additional buttons. Fusebox: The electrical panel is located inside the bedroom wardrobe. If there is no electricity in the apartment check the fuse switches are all in the on position. Please contact the property manager if you require further assistance. Dishwasher: Pull open the door and place one tablet inside the compartment on the inner door panel. Press the power button on the far right to turn the dishwasher on. Use the >> button to select preferred wash cycle settings. Gently push the door until it clicks shut then press and hold the play/pause button to begin the cycle. Oven: Rotate the left dial to select the cooking method and the right dial to select the cooking temperature. Turn both dials to off and ‘0’ position to turn off. To set a timer select the hourglass button next to the screen and adjust with -/+. Stovetop: Turn on the middle switch of the powerpoint located on the right hand side of the splash back behind the espresso machine. Once the switch is on you can now turn the cooktop on by rotating the dials. When finished turn the dial to the 0 off position and turn off the wall switch. Washing Machine: Pull open the door and place a load inside then gently push the door until it clicks shut. Pour the laundry liquid into the tray compartment on the left. Press the power button on the right and use the dial to select a cycle. Press the 'Start/Pause' button to begin the cycle. Dryer: Pull open the door and check the filter is empty before placing a load inside. Gently push the door until it clicks shut. Turn the dryer on by rotating the dial to the desired setting. Press the 'everyday' button to select a standard cycle then press the 'start' button to begin. Please remove the filter and clean out after each use. Upon arrival establish the location of the nearest ● Emergency exits ● Break glass alarm ● Fire hose reel ● Fire Extinguisher Fire Evacuation In Case of A Fire: - Take the apartment keys with you. - Test the doors and doorknobs to feel if it is warm or cool. If it is cool open the door slowly and proceed to the nearest exit. - Do not use the elevators. - If you must exit through smoke stay low to the ground and walls. In Case of a Fire: R – Remove yourself and others away from the danger area. A – Alert the Emergency Services and raise the alarm. C – Contain the danger – close all doors and windows. E – Evacuate to a safe area. Garbage Disposal / Housekeeping: Please act responsibly and to assist the property manager in limiting the amount of consumption generated from their apartments. Please take the following information into account: ● Please ensure that all lighting air conditioning heaters and electrical appliances are turned off when not in use. ● If you notice that a lightbulb is blown please contact the property manager so that they can arrange a replacement. ● Please dispose of rubbish and recyclables accordingly. Garbage Disposal: The waste room is located on Level B in the underground basement. Use the lift to access Level B then exit to your left and use the second door to the left to dispose of household waste and recycling. The property manager reserves the right to debit your credit card for any outstanding charges that apply to the booking. This includes extra cleaning excess rubbish removal late checkouts repairs and damage to property. You will be responsible for paying a callout or replacement fee if keys security fobs or parking remotes are lost stolen damaged or locked inside the apartment. You agree to keep the apartment in a clean and presentable condition during the occupancy and on departure. The property manger has a strict ‘No Smoking’ policy within the apartment the building or any part of the common areas. If you smoke in the apartment additional cleaning charges will apply. The property manager has a strict ‘No Party’ policy. You shall not allow the apartment or any part of the common areas to be used in such a manner as to cause a nuisance or disturbance to neighbours. Please be mindful of the neighbours and keep the noise levels to a minimum between the hours of 10:00pm to 7:00am. You are responsible to pay the cost of repairs and/or replacement to any fitting fixture or furnishing within the apartment or common area resulting from misuse. You must not move or remove any items from the apartment. Should any items not be found within the apartment on check out you will be charged the cost of replacement of any such item.

HouseRules1: All property bonds will be processed 72 hours prior to arrival. Please ensure you have the funds available on your credit card. If you will be arriving late (subject to office hours) please advise the office in advance. After-hour key collection is available at an additional charge which is to be paid for by the guest ($50 min). Your co-operation in leaving the property clean and tidy is requested. If the property is not left in an acceptable state an extra cleaning fee will be charged which includes the use and cleaning of outside BBQ’s. Excess rubbish from your stay will also be removed at your cost. After-hours call-outs considered a non-emergency may incur a fee which is to be paid for by the guest ($50 min). All expenses must be paid in full before you are issued with your key and check-in pack. All keys and remotes must be returned to the office upon check-out. Should you feel upon arrival or notice during your stay that the property is not clean or is in an unsatisfactory state of repair then you must immediately call the office and or after hours number and register your complaint. If no call is received or message left during your stay then the property is deemed to be in a satisfactory manner. Any comments made later than this will be taken as feedback for the cleaner etc and no offer of compensation will be applied. Our first option naturally is to rectify the problem should there be one. Any breakages damages and lost keys/remotes must be reported or if found on departure inspection by Accom Holidays must be paid for at the guest’s expense. We have the right to use the credit card bond for these expenses. Furniture should not be moved around the house and utensils crockery etc not to be removed from the premises. You will be liable for any damage caused from moving of furniture and bond charged accordingly. Accom Holidays and its respective franchises take no responsibility for any personal property left on the premises by the guest. Smoking is not permitted in any of our properties. Charges apply for bookings who dishonour this clause. Intent to film or photograph at this property for promotional/commercial purposes requires upfront approval by Accom Holidays Failing to do this will result in the content being unauthorised and immediate removal of this content will be required. This property is not a party house. Council Police and the local community have strict requirements in regard to nuisance noise and offensive behaviour. Please respect our local community and neighbours. Under Section 268 of the Protection Environment Operations Act 1997 a Complainant may be successful in obtaining a noise abatement order from the local court against the offender. Eviction and heavy penalties do apply. Number of guests should not exceed the number stated on the Registration Form or subsequently agreed in writing or email. This includes Visitors to the property at any time. Fees will apply for excess guests not agreed with the owners in advance. Parties functions and school leaver bookings are strictly prohibited. The price charged is for domestic use only and not commercial use. Party accessories including balloons banners etc are not to be displayed on the property under any circumstances. Accordingly this rate does not allow for the extra wear associated with functions in terms of cleaning garbage removal wear and tear repairs. Use contrary to this may result in the loss of your Security Deposit Bond and/or additional payments. Excessive use of any utilities (services such as electricity) will be charged Disturbance to our neighbours including excessive noise (by law) is prohibited and may result in termination of occupancy and total loss of Security Deposit Bond. As the guest you agree to allow the property’s respective managing agent Accom Holidays or a contractor to enter the premises in which you are staying to carry out necessary repairs or maintenance. Credit card details supplied are held as a security bond when a booking is made along with a specified Security Deposit Bond amount. Accom Holidays accepts bookings in good faith however we will not be held responsible for circumstances beyond our control.

HouseRules1: Upon arrival there will be 2 sets of keys in your apartment; 2 door keys 2 access fobs and 1 mailbox key. The fob is required to gain entrance into the building. There are 3 entrances you can use: ● Lobby Ground Floor ● Arch Lane B2 (basement level 2) ● River Walk B3 (basement level 3) Please ensure you take your keys with you whenever you leave your apartment as you will need the access fob to access your floor and all the building facilities (Gym Sauna Pool Spa Pool and BBQ area). In the lifts the only floor you can access without your fob is the ground floor. The front doors to the apartment lock automatically - please ensure you have apartment keys with you when you leave your apartment. Dishwasher Both tablets and dishwasher powder can be used in the dishwasher. Please do not use dishwashing liquid as the machine will overflow with bubbles and flood the kitchen. The full manual can be found in the cupboard above the fridge Laundry The instruction manual on how to use the washing machine can be found at the end of this information pack. The full manual can be found in the cupboard above the fridge. Rubbish Rubbish Chute rooms are located by the lifts. General waste must be placed in plastic bags and tied securely to prevent contents from escaping. The Rubbish Chute can be used between 7am and 10pm. If you would like to dispose of rubbish outside these hours (or have rubbish that will not fit in the chute) please put your rubbish in the bins on level B2. Glass items and recycling must not be placed in the rubbish chute. Recycling Paper cardboard glass plastic and cans need to be taken to the recycling bins on level B2. Please ensure all cardboard boxes are flattened before placing in the Recycling Bins Service Clean The apartment is cleaned weekly during which the cleaners will change the bed linen tea towel and bathroom towels etc. and clean the kitchen bathroom dust and vacuum/wash the floor. Staff are not permitted to move personal items – to facilitate a complete clean please ensure that surfaces are clear and that personal items and bags etc. are not left on the floor. Dishwashing is not part of a Service Clean. Please place any dirty dishes in the dishwasher. Consumables are provided upon check-in as a courtesy these are not replaced during the Service Cleans. You will be notified of the normal cleaning day on check-in – please let the Property Manager know if your scheduled day is inconvenient. Windows and Balcony Doors Please keep windows and balcony doors closed when you go out. Summer storms start very quickly and violently in Brisbane. The wind and rain that comes with them will damage the apartment furnishings. Please also be advised that guests are responsible for paying for any repairs due to wind or rain damage if doors and/or windows are left open. Appliances Manuals for the oven dishwasher washing machine and dryer are in the Manuals Folder in the bottom drawer in the kitchen. Smoke Detectors Smoke detector devices are fixed to the ceiling of your apartment. These devices will activate an audible alarm if smoke is detected in your apartment. If your alarm goes off while cooking please turn on your air con open your balcony doors and press the reset button on the smoke detector. Please do not open your front door. The smoke will trigger the smoke detectors in the hallway which triggers the evacuation alarm and the Fire Service automatically attends. The cost of these false alarms is invoiced directly to the occupant by the Fire Service. Building Facilities The building facilities are open from 6.00am to 10.00pm daily and are accessible from the ground floor. ● Gym ● Sauna ● Lap Pool and Spa Pool ● BBQ Area ● Lending Library in the Lobby (accessible 24/7) Maintenance For any maintenance matters please call Michael Flude on 0419 498 223. We work hard to have maintenance issues dealt with expediently as far as is possible.

Visitors: Visitors should call your apartment via the intercom at the entrance to the building on the ground floor. When you answer the intercom and are happy that the visitor is genuine let them in by pressing the “key” button on the base of the intercom. No Smoking: Smoking is not permitted anywhere in the apartment including balconies. Garbage: Garbage disposal is located on the ground floor near the entrance to the visitor car park on the Tench St side of the building. General waste must be placed in plastic bags and tied securely to prevent odours from escaping. There is one bin for garbage and one for recycling. Please do not leave food scraps or rubbish lying about in your kitchen. Cockroaches will find it very quickly and are then very difficult to eradicate from your apartment. Electrics Panel: In the unlikely event of electricity failure please check the distribution panel first to check for a tripped switch. Cleaning: If your stay is greater than nine days your apartment will be cleaned once per week. The cleaners will change the bed linen and towels clean the kitchen and bathroom and dust and vacuum/clean the floor. Please make sure that any bags are off the floor to facilitate the cleaning. They will not do the washing up if there are dirty dishes. You will be notified of the normal cleaning day on check-in – please let us know if this is inconvenient. Internet: The apartment has Internet connectivity the internet password is located on the modem. The download rate is moderate. Laundry: The laundry includes a washing machine iron and ironing board. When using the iron please do not iron plastics or synthetics that may burn and leave a residue on the iron’s surface. Environmental Considerations: Please be mindful of the wasteful use of energy/water and its impact on the environment. Please: ● turn off air conditioning or heaters when you leave the apartment. ● take measures to reduce water consumption. Windows and Doors: Please keep windows and doors closed if you are out. Canberra winters are severe and the temperature drops quickly in the evenings. Please also be advised that guests are responsible for paying for any repairs due to wind or rain damage if doors and/or windows are left open. Smoke Detection: Smoke detector devices are fixed to the ceiling of your apartment. These devices will activate an audible alarm if smoke is detected in your apartment. This device is isolated to your apartment. Fire Alarm and Exits: There is an occupant warning system. Fire engineers will test the alarm system from time to time. Emergency exits are clearly marked by green signs hanging from the ceilings in the hallways. Please familiarise yourself with the fire exits. In the event of an emergency follow the instructions of any authority. Exit the building following the ‘exit’ signs via the fire stairs. Emergency lighting will illuminate the emergency egress routes in the event of normal power failure. Do not use the lifts in emergencies. Insurance: If the property manager is required to claim on their insurance for damage caused by you or your visitors you will be required to pay any excess charges. Damages: Accidents do happen. Please notify us of any damages or breakages. Acceptance of the Terms and Conditions includes agreement to payment for any damage breakages or loss of any furniture fittings and/or equipment to the property its common areas and/or its contents and agrees to provide credit card details as payment for any such occurrence. This includes wind and or rain damage if doors or windows are left open.

HouseRules1: A reminder that excessive noise will not be tolerated at the property. Please be mindful of the neighbours and in particular minimise noise levels in the evenings as per local council legislation. IMPORTANT INFORMATION During your stay you are responsible for the safe keeping of the key and security of the property. Should you lose the key you will be charged for a replacement. Guests must not park on the Grass or nature strip of neighbouring properties and show consideration to neighbours and other vehicles. Any concerns with the property in regards to maintenance or other issues must be reported to the property within 18 hours of check in. Guests must dispose of garbage and recycling in accordance with the usual practice at the property and in the allocated bins. Guests must not leave excess rubbish in common or public areas and upon departure place ALL rubbish in external bins ready to go for Council Collection. Guests must notify the Agent of any complaints as soon as is practicable. All windows and doors must be locked upon departure. Please refer to the checklist in place at the premises prior to departing and ensure everything is in order. ITEMS LEFT BEHIND / LOST PROPERTY Please ensure all property belongings remain at the property and all your personal belongings are brought home with you. While we will make every effort to find it for you we take no responsibility if it is not recovered. If the property is found a service fee of $50 is applied to return the property to you by postage. Large or bulky items may incur a higher charge. Items will be held in the office for a maximum of 6 months. If they have not been collected by then items will be discarded/donated. The spa will be professionally cleaned and heated ready to use upon arrival. Please ensure you follow the spa safety instructions prior to entering the spa. We set the spa temperate at 38 degrees. - To adjust the temperature: Hold down the up arrow to turn the temperature up. Hold down the down arrow to turn temperature down. - Turning on the jets: On the bottom of the touchpad press the third button from the left hand side. (6 circles on button) A single press will turn the jets on in vari-speed mode. Use the up and down arrow buttons to vary the speed. Press 'ok' to confirm. Press the same button to turn the jets off as you did to turn the jets on - EPA regulations: In order to follow EPA regulations the spa pump must not be running between the hours of 10pm and 9am. Carpet - Please note: This property contains sisal carpet (made from natural fibres). Please be extra careful as this carpet cannot be steam cleaned and any damage will result in replacement. Coffee Machine: A Nespresso (essenza mini solo) coffee machine is available for guest use. Feel free to bring your own Nespresso pods otherwise compatible pods are available to purchase at IGA Woolworths or Coles. Firewood: Please be advised a modest supply of firewood will be available to guests during the months between May and August. For additional wood guests can choose to purchase 15kg bundles from PeninsulaHolidayRentals.com.au for $25 each delivered otherwise please feel free to purchase from the local service station and hardware store Hotel quality bed linen and bath towels are provided for your stay. Don't forget to pack your own beach towels! Council Bins: Council bins are collected on Monday morning. If the bins have not been placed on the curb before Sunday afternoon you may see our contractor taking the bins out for you to ensure they get emptied.

HouseRules1: AIR-CONDITIONING: Please only use air-conditioning when required and not left on when you have left the premises. Please only use the ON/OFF functions of the air-conditioning remote the temperatures have been set. The temperature that is displayed on the key pad is the current temperature at the time. Do not try and reset it it is set for 22 and as the property cools the temperature reading will show the progress. (Technicians fee may be charged if the system needs to be professionally reset). Regardless of the temperature set rooms will take 30 mins to reach setting. If a hot day is anticipated it is best to have the system on early so it doesn’t have to labour to reach 24. Research shows that 23-24 degrees is the optimum setting. Reducing the temp does NOT get the room cool faster. For quickest cooling ensure all windows blinds and doors are closed. Use ceiling fans to maximize effect. The system has to labour very hard if you leave the doors to decks or other areas open. If the system is turned off please wait a few minutes before turning on again. Please note that if we are at the property and the air con is running with you away we reserve the right to enter and turn it off. RUBBISH: Please ensure all bins are placed out for collection on Tuesday night curb side (lid opens towards street). - general waste bin has black or red lid and is collected weekly - yellow lid is for recyclables only. (Not plastic bags nor pizza boxes.) - yellow lid bins collected every 2 weeks - excess rubbish charges may be applied - please make sure all your rubbish has been put in the outside wheelie bins before you checkout of your rental property. LINEN: Please do not use the white towels to remove makeup or fake tan. Please do not use good linen or tea towels to wipe the floor or clean up spills such as red wine. Please note stains which can not be removed from linen may result in you being charged for the damages. FIRE SAFETY: Each kitchen area has a fire blanket and fire extinguisher in obvious locations. Please familiarise yourself with their positions on arrival. The smoke detectors in each room are hard wired with battery backup. UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCES CAN YOU REMOVE OR TAMPER WITH THESE UNITS. You will forfeit your bond if this occurs. DRYER: - lines are supplied and it would be appreciated if you use them - the dryers are for wet weather and urgent drying needs - please ensure that the filter is regularly emptied of fluff or the unit will overheat and stop working PETS: If excessive dog barking is reported you may be required to leave if the issue can't be resolved. You MUST pick up ALL your pet droppings it is not the cleaners responsibility to do that. Any furniture or doors/walls scratched by your pet will need to be paid for to repair or replace. Pets cannot be in the carpeted areas nor on furniture. Excessive hair shedding is your responsibility to remove before vacating. SERVICING: Please note holiday homes do not include a service component for cleaning or linen change regardless of length of stay. There are washing facilities and some basic cleaning items. Vacuum broom mop and dustpan. Full laundry - washing machine iron and ironing board. ORNAMENTS ETC: Some beautiful pieces have been purchased to complete the décor suitable for this executive home. If you have children please ensure these items are placed somewhere safe where we can find them when you vacate. Breakages will need to be paid for. SWIMMING POOL - No running around the swimming pool no diving nor standing on the edge - Children under the age of twelve (12) years must be accompanied by an adult - Glass containers are not be permitted in the swimming pools or enclosure - No unnecessary noise - Pets and animals are not permitted into the swimming pools or enclosure - Alcoholic beverages cannot be consumed in the swimming pool - No splashing or behaving in any manner likely to annoy neighbours

HouseRules1: Under Victorian legislation neighbours are not to be disturbed by short-stay guests in any way. Fines may apply for each and every individual neighbour who is disturbed: on each occasion. Also smoking is strictly not allowed in the property hallways elevators or lobbies (where relevant). A fee to clean and deodorise the apartment due to smoke damage will apply. If anyone is found on CCTV cameras (where relevant) to be smoking in any of the above areas the booking may be cancelled immediately. Footage can also be checked well after departure. Housekeeping: If you’re going to be with us longer than a month interim cleaning will generally commence on the next business day 28 days after you check-in; or about mid-way through your stay if it’s more than 28 days but less than 56 etc. Our cleaners will try to confirm with you when the clean is to be scheduled. Please note that the regular cleaning day may be delayed by a day or two at any time without notice due to other cleaning commitments heavy traffic major events in the city etc. Interim cleaning services generally include cleaning of floors kitchen and bathrooms and changing of linen but the property needs to be maintained in a clean and tidy state. If you leave a mess in the kitchen for instance the cleaners will only be able to clean around this. If you leave personal items on the beds they will not be able to change the sheets. If you’d like to reschedule your clean please contact the cleaners directly at least 24 hours before the scheduled day so they can try and reschedule their next visit on your required date. If you turn the cleaners away without this notice they will charge the property manager a returning fee which they will unfortunately have to pass on to you. Please remove all your rubbish to the bins. Cleaners will not empty or remove your rubbish. Housekeeping can be contacted on 0411 629 541. Breakages and Maintenance Issues: Please let us know if there have been any accidental breakages so we can replace the broken items. If you experience any maintenance or other issues during your stay please don’t wait to tell the property manager. They can’t help you if you tell them about it after you leave. They would also like to know about it before your departure date so they can get someone in straight away to try and fix it before the next guests arrive. Rubbish: General During your stay you to dispose of your rubbish and recycling in the rubbish and recycling bins. Recycling There may be instructions on how to sort the recycling so please follow them. Plastic bags and plastic wrap are NOT recyclable so please leave all items you place in the recycling LOOSE and UNWRAPPED please. (Bags of recycling will not be recycled; so this defeats the point of putting items in the recycling bins). Spare Towels and Cleaning Products: Spare towels can be found in the bedroom cupboards. Cleaning products if you need them can be found under the kitchen sink. Wi-fi Access: It’s important that you don’t: Change any of the cables connected to the phone or the wall outlet Reset the Router House Rules: The number of guests staying at the property must not exceed the number agreed to in the booking details. If any additional persons stay at the property an additional fee may be charged or the property manager reserve the right to terminate the booking. For pet friendly properties if extensive additional cleaning is required this will be charged to your credit card provided. The general house rules for pet guests are to not allow them on the beds and furniture not to allow them to damage any property and to clean up after them before leaving the property. Guests will be liable for any necessary cleaning and dry-cleaning if required. You will agree to any other reasonable house rules which may be made available to you at the property. This property is part of a residential apartment complex guest are required to enter and exit the property without disturbing other residents of the complex. For all properties the noise level must be inaudible from neighbouring properties between 10:00pm and 8:00am Sunday - Thursday nights and between 11:00pm and 9:00am Friday - Saturday nights. All guests are expected to behave in a manner that does not cause distress to neighbours or interfere in any way with their right to enjoy their properties. The property manger reserves the right to remove guests who do not adhere to this code of behaviour. The property has a ‘No-Party’ policy. Automatic fines apply to any guest who disturbs neighbours with parties. Guests may not engage in any illegal activity at the property. Breakages Loses and Guest Charges: Please leave the property in the state in which you found it on arrival. All breakages or losses must be reported immediately. It is our policy to have all locks changed if keys are lost or not returned. All associated costs will be charged to the credit card provided if this occurs. Similarly any remote controls will be replaced at your cost if lost or not returned. Excessive use of any of these utilities may be charged to the credit card provided. Costs for additional calls may be passed onto guests. Neither the property manager nor the owners of the property are liable for loss to you of any personal belongings while you are in the property. Guest items found by our cleaning staff are kept in the property managers office for one month before discarding. It is the guest’s responsibility to follow up any items that may have been left behind at the property. They request that guests send a reply-paid envelope to the property manager in order for them to return the items. Alternatively for large items they may be able to bill your credit card for postage and handling. Locked Out: Contact Irene or the property manager on the number above: Third point of contact: our preferred locksmith Damian on 0411 493 550 – available 24 hours - fees apply directly to Damian. Lost Keys: Unfortunately replacing keys and locks is an expensive task. To replace multiple sets of keys and their matching locks the property manager will have to pass this cost on to you. If you happen to take a set of keys with you by accident when you depart please notify the property manager immediately and return them to them within 48 hours to avoid having to replace the keys and locks. Heating and Cooling: Most reverse-cycle units are similar and there may be slight differences at each property but they generally work as follows: Press the MODE button. The 'snowflake' symbol indicates cooling. The ‘sun’ symbol indicates heating. Don’t use the “AUTO” setting for the FAN or Mode Don't use the dehumidify (water drop) setting. If you keep all the doors and windows closed the property will heat up or cool down fairly quickly even on a moderate temperature setting. You don’t need to set the temperature very high or low in order to achieve a comfortable temperature. Please turn off the unit when you go out or have windows and doors open. Manuals: You should find all the manuals for all the electrical appliances throughout the property (including the stove air-con TV’s washing machine and kitchen appliances) in the bottom draw of the kitchen or in the back of the guest information folder. If there are any manuals missing please let us know. Important: Please ensure when using the clothes dryer that you clean the filter before each use. This can be a fire hazard! Please never ever leave the property with the clothes dryer washing machine or even the dishwasher running. These are fire hazards and you will be held responsible. Please turn things off when you’re out. If you’re going out please remember to turn off heating cooling lighting irons etc and turn off any large appliances (except fridges) at the wall if possible before you go. Fire Safety: A fire blanket and fire extinguisher are provided in your apartment. Please familiarise yourself with their locations. If you are in an apartment complex and happen to burn something in the kitchen and it fills with smoke DO NOT open the door to the hallway as this can set off the building’s fire alarms. In a false alarm situation the Fire Department charges HEAVY FINES for the call out and these will be payable by you under the Owner’s Corporation Rules of the building. Turning on the aircon (on the high fan setting) the range hood fan on high the exhaust fans and opening all the windows is a much better option. Security: Please ensure you lock all the doors and windows each time you exit the property. You should take care regarding security and for your own peace of mind. We advise keeping all doors to the property locked at all times.

HouseRules1: The following strict house rules apply: To help protect all floor coverings do not wear any shoes inside the property. No loud noise is permitted between 10:00pm and 8:00am as well as no antisocial behaviour or parties. No additional people are to access the property without prior approval. No smoking is permitted on the property at any time. Please notify us immediately if you break something. Any breach of the house rules may lead to a fine plus compensation for any cost/damage created and immediate eviction of the property. Lost or stolen keys will incur a replacement fee.﻿ Please also note that if you lock yourself out during weekday business hours (9:00 am to 5:00 pm) we may arrange for an additional key (if available) at an extra charge. After hours/weekends a locksmith will have to be arranged which you will need to cover the cost for. Oven: Turn the dial to the desired temperature the oven indicator light will turn on. Use the control knobs to select features such as grill fan forced cooking timer switch etc. The oven should turn off automatically once the timer count down is complete. Remember to turn the oven off manually if the timer has not been used. Microwave Oven: Please do not use metal utensils including aluminium foil whilst using the microwave. Please place food in the microwave with the splash cover if required choose the desired setting – power time and press the start button. Please note that some Tupperware and plastic containers are not microwave safe - please look for the symbol enclosed if you are not sure prior to using them in microwave/dishwasher. These symbols are normally located at the rear of the utensil i.e. plate cutlery etc. Kettle: Ensure that the kettle is filled with water however not above the maximum level line as indicated on the kettle. Fuse Box: The fuse box is located in the kitchen in the cabinet on top of the kettle. Garbage: Please note the bins are location at the front of the building. Housekeeping: Kindly note that your home is not serviced during your stay. Troubleshooting Wi-Fi: > Please switch off the router. > Disconnect all the cables. > Wait for 15 minutes. > Reconnect all the cables to the same positions. > Please switch on the router/NBN box. > Wait another minute. If the property has a dongle. If the Dongle is not working properly please follow the next steps: 1. Go to settings 2. Then go to more. 3. then you should be able to do a factory reset. Troubleshooting TV: Make sure the TV is plugged in and the wall switch is on. Check the fuse or circuit breaker. Test the outlet with a lamp. Make sure the TV is connected to the aerial wall plate. Use channel select or input select to switch the source. Put the TV onto the component 2 channel. It's with the LG remote and you press the source button. Then check the set top box is on. Change the channels with the up and down button on the box itself. Washing Machine: The washing machine and the dryer are in a foreign language. See conversion instructions. Check power is on & machine is plugged in Machine isn’t overloaded Load isn’t bunched to one side during spin cycle (generally towels) Water to machine is on Check drain pipe is connected to machine and leading into sink or pipe Check settings Dryer: The dryer is a condescending dryer the drawer needs emptying frequently. Check power is on & machine is plugged in Check door closes Check settings

HouseRules1: Dishwasher: -Please scrape plates before putting them in the dishwasher. -Dishwashing tablets and rinse aid are located under the sink. -We recommend using the “autowash” or “autowash gentle” (a faster cycle) settings. Nespresso Machine and Milk Frother: If it is switched on at the wall press either the small or large cup setting and the buttons will flash green to show that the machine is warming up. Please make sure that the tank at the back has enough water. It is simple to pull out and refill. Once the green lights stop flashing pull the handle at the front up and drop a pod in (alfoil top facing forward) and pull the handle down. Place your mug under the spout. The mugs at Hanalei are too tall to sit on the drip tray stand. This flips up easily and the mug slots in nicely under the spout. Then press the button that corresponds to the size of coffee you want. To empty the used pods from the machine pull out the drip tray and the receptacle behind it containing the used pods can be emptied into the bin and put back in place. For a milky coffee the milk frother has a button on the front that you press to turn on. Pour in the milk noting the maximum levels it take (the hot milk one is the lower one). Then press the button and it foams up in a minute or two. Please clean out the frother (taking care not to lose the magnetic frothing agitator after each use. Please note: the coffee machine uses Nespresso pods. A starting amount is provided but you may wish to bring additional pods with you. Washing Machine and Dryer: The detergent for the washing machine goes into the left most dispenser in the drawer on the top left of the front face of the machine. If you want to soak/prewash items first the powder goes in the right hand drawer. Fabric softener is not supplied but if you bring your own it goes in the middle dispenser. The dryer is a simple vented dryer. Please put the laundry door ajar with the wedge if you’re using the dryer to keep condensation from forming. Please clean the lint filter after each use. It is a disc at the back of the dryer. There is an exhaust filter attached to the back – please keep this and replace it on the back once you have removed the lint from the lint filter by pulling apart the disc. There are also instructions on the side of the dryer. Garbage: Collection day is Tuesday morning. Please place all bins to kerb on Monday Night Barbecue: The barbecue is a Weber Family Q. To use it check that the gas supply from the cylinder is switched on. To switch the barbecue on turn the large knob to the light position and press the ignition button. After this burner has lit turn on the other burner if required. Weber recommends cooking with the lid closed. Please clean the BBQ after use. If you run out of gas there is a spare gas canister. Please place empty cylinders inside the house so we know to refill it for our next guests. Air conditioning Unit kitchen/dining and King bedroom. The air conditioning can both heat and cool. The remote control for the one in the kitchen is on the wall next to the tall cupboards. The remote control for the king bedroom is on the wall next to the light switches (near the sliding door). Press the mode button to cycle through heating cooling or fan. Cooling is displayed as a snowflake heating with a sun shape. You can also adjust the strength of the air output by pressing the fan button while heating or cooling. Press L/R to move airflow left or right. Please DO NOT move the air gliders by hand as this will break the unit. Please also do not set any on/off timers as this will cause the unit to switch on and waste electricity when the property is vacant. There are two oil fin heaters and a spare blanket for each bed stored in the built in wardrobes.

CheckInDetails: The key or keys are stored in a key safe at the property accessed by a code unique to your booking. The access code will be sent to you by SMS just prior to check-in time on the day of your arrival. The most important thing to know about your arrival is that the front door on the old house is not a door! It used to be a door but we removed the corridor behind it during the renovation to make more space in the bedrooms. It’s now just a dummy door that’s been retained for aesthetics but doesn’t go anywhere! The front door is actually on the left hand side by the side of the driveway about midway along the house at the start of the extension. The driveway’s also the best place to park (and the most convenient when you have your luggage) but there’s also a wide gravel parking strip along the road. You will find the key box on the left side of the door frame. Inside there are two keys one which opens the front door and the other which opens the back door via the rear deck. You will have been sent the key box code separately. Once inside you will be able to open all the other doors and windows without a key. Please note that the shed is not accessible to guests. There are also cupboards in the laundry kitchen and under the island bench that are locked and not accessible. These cupboards are clearly marked to distinguish them from the unlocked cupboards which you can use.

HouseRules1: Heating and Aircon: The entire house has split system air-con and heating. There is a controller in the family room and each bedroom each mounted on the wall near the unit. Please don’t leave these on when you’re out and about they are very quick to cool or heat once turned on. There is also a wood burner in the family room and a fireplace in the study. Wood Burner: There are fire-starters and matches in the laundry cupboard. The kindling and firewood are in a stand by the side of the wood burner and there is more in baskets on the rear deck. To use the wood burner you should first arrange the air vents properly. There is a knob on the left side of the burner. Pull this out. There is also a slider on the front door. Slide this fully to the left. This allows maximum airflow while you are getting your fire going. Then set up and ignite your fire like normal and close the door. Keep the door completely closed at all times when using the fire other than to add more wood (this enables the fire to draw properly and avoids embers escaping and burning the floor). Once your fire is going well push in the knob on the left and use the slider on the front to control the airflow (the more to the right it is the less air will flow and the slower it will burn). Oven and Cooktop: There is an electric oven and induction cooktop. There is a master switch on the back wall behind the cooktop on the left hand side. You’ll need to turn this on to get power to the oven and cooktop. If you haven’t used an induction cooktop before it’s great but may take a little getting used to. The power button is on the right. You then select which hob by pressing on the equivalent button on the panel and then use the +/- buttons in the middle to set the temperature. 4 or 5 is about medium heat 7 is hot. You probably won’t need to go above 7. When using the induction stovetop coffee pot 4 or 5 on one of the small hobs is sufficient (listen for the whistle when it’s done). Please note the hobs will remain hot for a while after they’re switched off. Please use the extraction fan above the cooktop when cooking (there are lights there too). Manuals: In the bottom drawer to the right of the kitchen sink you will find a set of manuals for most appliances in the house. Cleaning Products: There’s a stick vacuum in the laundry and a broom and mop in the middle laundry cupboard. Cleaning products are in the same cupboard and kitchen products are under the kitchen sink. There are also tea towels and other things in the drawers by the side of the sink. Outdoor Cushions and BBQ There are outdoor cushions for the patio seats on the benches along the patio. It would be much appreciated if you would put them back before you leave. There is also a gas BBQ with utensils in the kitchen drawers. The gas will need to be turned on at the bottle and please close this again after use.

HouseRules1: Using the Door Keypad 1) Touch/swipe the lock screen so it lights up. Enter the access code provided to you followed by the # key then simply use the door handle to open the door. That's it! 2) The door is automatically locked from outside within a few seconds. For fire safety the door is always unlocked from inside to enable a quick and easy exit. Note: If you slide the lever on the inside of the door it will change the door lock into passage mode (unlocked from outside and inside) LAUNDRY After running a load of washing please wipe down the glass door check the rubber seal for any debris and leave the washing machine door slightly open to air it out and allow the machine to dry out. This will keep it fresh and prevent mould growth. For safety please empty the lint catcher in the dryer before and after every use. To access the lint catcher open the door and gently pull it straight out from its place in the door rim. After emptying slide it back in making sure to push it all the way back in until it clicks into place. When using the laundry please keep the window and door open if possible for adequate airflow to help prevent mould growth in the room. BINS As this is a residential home please help out like previous guests have before you and kindly put the bins out for council collection if bin day falls during your booked dates. The blue lid bin is the general waste bin and is emptied on a weekly basis. The yellow lid bin is for recyclables and is only emptied fortnightly. There's a bin collection schedule on the fridge for your easy reference. The bins need to be placed out at the kerbside on Tuesday nights ready for collection by 6am Wednesday. Once they’ve been emptied please bring them back to their place under the stairs. Checking Out Before leaving please kindly: 1) Wash dry and put away all the dishes to avoid an extra cleaning fee from the cleaner. 2) Empty the fridge and freezer and take all rubbish out to the council bins outside. The blue bin is for general rubbish. The yellow bin is for recyclables ONLY. See the guide on the fridge as to what can be put in the yellow bin. The council will not empty the yellow bin if it is contaminated and will issue fines for incorrect use so please take care with the contents. If unsure just put it in the blue bin. 3) If you’ve used the oven make sure there is no baked on mess. Deep cleans of the oven to remove baked on mess will incur extra charges from the cleaner. 4) Leave the used beds unmade no need to strip them. 5) Place all bath linen in the shower. 6) Make sure all the windows and blinds are closed for security and weather purposes. 7) Make sure the front door is closed properly with the digital lock re-engaged upon leaving. 8) Let me know if you’ve noticed any maintenance issues. 9) Let me know if there’s been any accidental breakages of crockery etc. so they can be promptly replaced for the next guest.

HouseRules1: Our home is our home too and we appreciate that our guests respect it like it’s theirs. his duplex is located in a residential neighbourhood - please respect neighbours and observe quiet time between 10pm and 8am. Two bins are taken out on the grassed area in front of the gutter. The red bin every week and alternating weeks with the blue and yellow. RED LID BIN: General rubbish – food scraps plastic wraps etc Please remember to not put wet towels or clothing on furniture or bedding. YELLOW BIN: Plastics aluminium glass bottles cans of tuna beans etc washed out first NOT PLASTIC WRAPPING BLUE BIN: Paper and card only Two bins must be brought out on the grass strip closest to the gutter every Tuesday night. The red bin is weekly and the recycling alternates each week. Please always remember to bring the rubbish and recycling bins in after collection. The shower screen doors need to be left closed after showering so that the water drips inside the shower area otherwise water will flood the outside. Washing machine can take a quicker wash by lowering the temperature and leaving the spin on the highest and pressing the quick button before the start. Dishwasher has different programs just press the P1 P2 or whichever suits the dishes to be washed and press start. Please do not place plastic cups or knives from the block inside. Please make use of make up wipes not our towels for removal of make up and sunscreen. Please do not dispose of baby wipes or sanitary items in the toilets. Please remember to not put wet towels or clothing on furniture or bedding. Please have all dishes pots and pans washed. Please note the BBQ is connected to natural gas and need to be cleaned after each use. Please ensure to clean BBQ plates grill and trays after use which are located under the hot plates. Please use only wooden and plastic utensil on non-stick pans. Please use special cleaning powder supplied for stainless steel cookware. Please maintain a clean and tidy home during your stay.

Heating and Cooling : A heating and cooling unit is located on the living room wall near the ceiling. There is a remote control for this that you’ll need to use in order to turn the system on. The wall unit may display a light but you will need to press the red power button on the remote to turn the unit on as it doesn’t turn on automatically. To change between heating and cooling Most reverse-cycle units are similar and there may be slight differences at each property but they generally work as follows: Press the MODE button. The 'snowflake' symbol indicates cooling. The ‘sun’ symbol indicates heating. Don’t use the “AUTO” setting for the FAN or Mode Don't use the dehumidify (water drop) setting. Recommended temperatures If you keep all the doors and windows closed the property will heat up or cool down fairly quickly even on a moderate temperature setting. You don’t need to set the temperature very high or low in order to achieve a comfortable temperature. The Department of Environment and Sustainability recommend you start the temperature at 20°C for both heating and cooling and adjust from there. Rubbish : During your stay we’d greatly appreciate it if you’d dispose of your rubbish in the rubbish bins in the Bin Room located in the corner of the car park on the lower ground level. Recycling : Similarly if you’ve got any recycling this can be disposed of in recycling bins in the Bin Room located in the car park on the lower ground level. There are instructions on how to sort the recycling so please follow them. Plastic bags and plastic wrap are not recyclable so please leave all items you place in the recycling loose and unwrapped. HouseRules1: Intercom: You can provide your visitors with access to the building from within the apartment by using the intercom. Press the button with a key symbol on the intercom handset to release the main entrance allowing your visitor entry to the building. They can then proceed to the elevator and continue to the floor where the apartment is located Internet: If you are experiencing difficulties with the Internet unplug the modem’s power cable from the outlet and leave it disconnected for 2 minutes. After 2 minutes reconnect the power wait for the lights on the modem to turn green and try to reconnect to the Wi-Fi on your devices. If you are still experiencing issues please contact the Guest Experience team. Please DO NOT reset the modem. Television: All our apartments contain SmartTVs with access to all your personal streaming services. Simply select the Netflix or YouTube button on the TV remote and log in using your personal account details. To watch Free to Air channels press the Source/Input button on the remote and change the source to DTV. If you experience any difficulties operating the system please do not hesitate to contact the Guest Experience team at support@stayurbanrest.com Fire Safety & Awareness: Each apartment is fitted with smoke detectors. In case of a fire please do not use the elevator and proceed to the nearest fire escape which is clearly indicated with exit signage in accordance with all building standards and statutory requirements. Appliances: Air Conditioning The air conditioner is controlled by the Mitsubishi Electric panel located on the living room wall. Press the power button to turn the air conditioner on and off. Use the panel to change the mode temperature and fan speed to your preference. Fusebox The electrical panel is located inside the apartment on the living room wall. If there is no electricity in theapartment check the fuse switches are all in the ON position. Please contact the Guest Experience team if you require further assistance. Dishwasher Pull open the door and place a load inside then gently push the door until it clicks shut. Press the ‘ON/OFF’ button to turn the dishwasher on then use the corresponding buttons to select a cycle. Press the ‘Start/Pause’ button to begin the cycle. Oven Bring power to the oven using the switch marked ‘HOB’ on the splashback wall. Press the ‘ON/OFF’ button on the left to turn the oven on. Adjust the operating settings using the corresponding buttons and rotary selection panel. Then press the ‘Start/Stop’ button to begin cooking. Press the ‘ON/OFF’ button on the left to turn the oven off. Please close the door after each use. Stovetop Bring power to the stovetop using the switch marked ‘HOB’ on the splashback wall. Press and hold the 0/I button to turn the stovetop on. Place your pot/pan on the hotplate then select the hotplate by pressing the respective button. Touch the + or - symbol to adjust the temperature. Turn the stovetop off by flicking the ‘HOB’ switch off at the wall. Washing Machine Pull open the door and place a load inside then gently push the door until it clicks shut. Pour the provided laundry liquid into the tray compartment on the left. Press the power button on the right and use the dial to select a cycle. Press the 'Start/Pause' button to begin the cycle. Dryer Pull open the door and check the filter is empty before placing a load inside. Gently push the door until it clicks shut. Turn the dryer on using the power button on the left. Press the 'Everyday' button to select a standard cycle then press the 'Start/Pause' button to begin. Please remove the filter and clean out after each use. Ventilation System This apartment has an extraction fan in the bathroom as well as the laundry. These fans are connected to a ventilation system which is controlled using the panel located on the living room wall directly underneath the air conditioning control panel. Using this system is optional however it will maximize the efficiency of these extraction fans clearing the apartment of any steam or smoke produced as a result of showering cooking etc. Use the control panel to operate the system and adjust the fan speed. Once you are satisfied with the quality of the air in the apartment or in order to silence the fan sound above the front door switch off all extraction fans at their respective wall switches and turn off the ventilation system. Garbage Disposal / Housekeeping Caring for the Environment We encourage all our guests to act responsibly and to assist us in limiting the amount of consumption generated from our apartments Please take the following information into account: ● Please ensure that all lighting air conditioning heaters and electrical appliances are turned off when not in use. ● If you notice that a lightbulb is blown please contact Guest Experience so we can arrange a replacement. ● Please dispose of rubbish and recyclables accordingly Garbage Disposal There is a designated garbage/recycling room on the Ground Floor located next to the indoor pool. To access the waste room exit the apartment and turn left. Take the elevator down to Level G and exit the elevator then turn right. Find a door marked ‘Waste Room’ on your right. Use your swipe card to enter and exit the room. Make sure to always carry your fob as it is needed to exit the waste room from the inside. There is a strict ‘No Party’ policy. The guest shall not allow the Apartment or any part of the common areas to be used in such a manner as to cause a nuisance or disturbance to neighbors. Please be mindful of the neighbors and keep the noise levels to a minimum between the hours of 10:00 pm to 7:00 am. There is a strict ‘No Smoking’ policy within the apartment the building or any part of the common areas. If you smoke in the apartment additional cleaning charges will apply.

Bins: As this is a residential home please kindly help out like guests before you and take the bins out to the kerbside if you're at the house the night before bin day. The general rubbish bin is emptied every week and the recycling bin is emptied only once every 2 weeks. There’s a schedule on the fridge for your easy reference and a reminder posted on the back of the front door. If for any reason you're unable to put the bin out please let us know in advance so we can make alternative arrangements Gardener: About once a month a gardener attends to maintain the yard. If his visit happens to fall during your stay we'll let you know the day before he's due to attend. You do not need to be home for his visit. He will not require any access to the inside of the house Checking Out Before leaving please kindly: 1) Wash dry and put away all the dishes to avoid an extra cleaning fee from the cleaner. 2) Empty the fridge and freezer and take all rubbish out to the council bins outside. The blue bin is for general rubbish. The yellow bin is for recyclables ONLY. See the guide on the fridge as to what can be put in the yellow bin. You’ll hear the bolt moving to unlock - when it’s done moving you can push the door open. When unlocking and locking the door please apply pressure to the door by either pulling on the handle (from outside) or pushing on the door (from inside) for at least 3 seconds while the door bolt is moving to help it line up with the door frame and avoid errors. The door auto-locks after about 15 seconds. Remember you need to apply pressure and hold the door in place for it to work properly. If you don't want to wait 15 seconds you can also push the padlock icon with X symbol from the outside or use the thumb lever from inside. Note: Due to natural expansion and contraction of the door with temperature changes please pull on the door handle (from outside) while the door bolt is moving to help it move freely while locking and unlocking the door. The bolt will automatically extend after about 15 seconds to relock the door. If you leave the door open to bring in your belongings please take care to use the thumb lever on the back of the unit to retract the bolt before closing the door. To lock the door from the outside continue to pull on the door handle to keep the door firmly closed then press the “padlock with X” button. To lock the door from the inside turn the thumb lever.

WASHING MACHINE CARE Please make sure any objects in pockets are removed and all zips and buttons are done up on your garments before putting them in the machine. Remove washing as soon as the machine finishes and leave the door open to air out the machine after use. This helps to keep the machine fresh and prevent mould growth. TIP: check the fold in the rubber door seal before and after each cycle as any debris accidentally left in pockets during the washing cycle or sometimes even socks will end up here and can block up the drainage of the machine in the next cycle. DRYER CARE For fire safety please empty the lint catcher in the dryer before and after every use. To access the lint catcher open the door and gently pull it straight out from its place in the door rim. After emptying slide it back in making sure to push it all the way back in until it clicks into place. When using the dryer please keep the internal laundry door open for airflow to prevent humidity build-up in the room. BINS As this is a residential home please help out like previous guests have before you and kindly put the bins out for council collection if bin day falls during your booked dates. The blue lid bin is the general waste bin and is emptied on a weekly basis. The yellow lid bin is for recyclables and is only collected fortnightly. There's a bin collection schedule on the fridge for your easy reference. The bins need to be placed out at the kerbside on Thursday nights ready for collection Friday morning. Once they have been emptied please bring them back onto the property next to the fence. GARDENING About once a month the gardener attends to mow the front lawn. He won't need access to inside the house at all and you don't need to be home. We'll let you know the day before he's due to attend. For your easy reference the check out list is below.
